* Conduct high-quality outbound and inbound calls with working professionals, senior executives, and prospective students.
* Effectively communicate the value proposition, learning outcomes, and career relevance of ISB’s programmes.
* Build meaningful relationships with prospective candidates through professional and mature communication.
* Handle candidate queries with confidence, empathy, and clarity.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective candidates and ensure timely movement through the admissions funnel.
* Identify serious and high-potential prospects and nurture them towards application and enrolment.

* Manage and nurture leads received through digital marketing, webinars, referrals, events, and other sources.
* Ensure timely follow-up and accurate updating of lead status in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Track lead progression from enquiry to application, interview, offer, and enrolment.
* Identify reasons for lead drop-offs and recommend improvements to enhance conversion.
* Focus on generating quality applications and enrolments aligned with programme eligibility and profile requirements.
* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion outcomes.

* Guide candidates through the application process, including eligibility, SOP, video essay, supporting documents, and deadlines.
* Clarify programme-related queries and provide accurate information to applicants.
* Support candidates in understanding the application requirements and submission timelines.
* Coordinate with the relevant internal teams for application-related concerns.
* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the admissions journey.

* Coordinate with Programme Leads, Faculty, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the execution of information sessions, webinars, application guidance workshops, and alumni engagement activities.
* Assist in coordinating candidate interviews, shortlisting, and other admissions-related activities.
* Maintain effective communication with applicants, alumni, corporate representatives, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Reporting & Data Management
* Maintain accurate and updated admissions records in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Prepare regular reports on leads, applications, offers, enrolments, conversion rates, and pending follow-ups.
* Analyse admissions funnel performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Track programme-wise targets and provide timely updates to the reporting manager.
* Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with institutional processes.

* Support admissions campaigns and outreach initiatives for assigned AMPs.
* Participate in webinars, candidate engagement activities, alumni interactions, and programme promotion events.
* Leverage alumni referrals, professional networks, and other outreach opportunities to generate prospective leads.
* Communicate programme differentiators, faculty expertise, peer learning, and institutional value effectively.
* Contribute ideas to improve programme visibility, candidate engagement, and enrolment outcomes.

* Identify opportunities to improve admissions processes, candidate communication, and conversion strategies.
* Share insights from candidate interactions to strengthen programme positioning and marketing communication.
* Support team members in resolving candidate queries and operational challenges.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
  
  
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
  
  
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
  
  
**The team**

* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.

Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**

* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.

**Core Consulting**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.

**Preferred:**

* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)

title: Sr Regional Business Manager( South), India Region
description:
**SUMMARY**

The role as a Sr. Regional Business Manager is to manage the development of the region’s sales & distribution network and coordinate the sales efforts of the regional sales channels. The main responsibility is to ensure that the forecast is on target, the individual will be responsible for managing and owning to but not limited to order, revenue & margin aspects of the business for Accuray products and solutions. This includes the development of regional sales strategies adapted to the specific market situations and needs based on detailed market analysis. Leading cross functional team building efforts within the Region, in particular the coordination with the Service and Marketing Teams. The Regional Business Manager will work with the Senior Regional Business Director to develop specific sales plans to effectively win orders with new customers and new orders with existing customers and lead the sales process to successful customer acceptance and margin turnovers. The Individual must have a strong sales/commercial track record as individual contributor in medical devices & life Sciences domains.

The work location is in Remote-India preferably in Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai.

The role reports into the Senior Regional Business Director – India & Subcontinent.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for managing commercial and sales targets for the region mainly but not limited to new orders, revenue, margins, upgrades sales & market share aspects of the business. Contribute to timely renewal of service contracts in the assigned territory.
* The individual has to carry out business by accurately positioning Accuray’s products and portfolios in Private market, Strategic Accounts & Govt. accounts while maintaining high visibility in assigned geography to ultimately gain the market share.
* Assess individual markets and develop together with the Marketing, Service teams and Senior Regional Business Director, sales and marketing plans and strategies to achieve business goals with prospects and existing customers for new system sales.
* Develop relationships and build Accuray advocacy within the respective territory.
* Coordinate all regional sales activities to achieve the quarterly and yearly goals. Ability to forecast the business imperatives and maintain linearity of business on Quarter-to-Quarter basis.
* Develop reference centers for the region.
* Assist the sales channels in the preparation of high-level proposals and product/clinical features, advantages, and benefits (FAB) to medical physicists, oncologists, and key administrators.
* Participate in customer training programs, industry symposia and trade shows.
* Build and keep the funnel in SalesForce.com (Customer Relationship Management System) up to date in order to deliver a reliable forecast to the management.
* Ensure safety and quality considerations and requirements are proactively addressed and implemented in marketing & customer requirements.
* Follow the timeline for internal QA-related tasks, like Accuray University.
* Address and report in a timely fashion safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff.
* Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety & Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others
* Inform the Regional Business Director about the competitive landscape and advice for pricing strategies for the respective territory.
* Managing accolated quarterly budget for Travel, lodging & business expenses and accurately reporting of same.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor/Master’s degree in biomedical engineering or related field is required.
* Minimum 10 years professional sales experience of medical equipment with specific knowledge of the assigned territory is highly desired. Other related experience may also be considered.
* Familiarity and experience with oncology, radiotherapy, IMRT, Radiosurgery, Medical Physics, and other hospital/healthcare practices.
* Excellent level of English (read, written, spoken). Local language, Tamil, Telegu and Kannada will be an added advantage.
* Experience demonstrating strong written and verbal skills including an ability to present.
* Excellent customer relation skills, problem solving and stakeholder management in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with the use of standard office software programs including spreadsheet, word-processing, email applications and Power Point.
* Ability to be self-motivated and to work independently.
* Capability to work home based while keeping a high standard of motivation, professionalism, and ethic.
* Team worker and loyal team member
* Dynamic, proactive, and driven to high levels of accomplishment.
* Willingness to travel at least 60% of the time.

title: Associate Business Consultant - CRM
description:
Associate Business Consultant – CRM & Marketing Automation
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India (Work from Office)
  
  
Company: DigiDelight
  
  
Experience: 1–3 Years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About DigiDelight
  
  
DigiDelight is an enterprise technology company developing innovative solutions that help organizations transform their business operations, customer engagement, and digital processes.
  
  
Our flagship CRM and marketing automation platform, DigiCRM, enables organizations to manage customer relationships, sales pipelines, marketing campaigns, customer journeys, and business workflows through an integrated digital platform.
  
  
We are looking for an enthusiastic, business-oriented professional who wants to build a career at the intersection of marketing, business consulting, and enterprise technology.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are hiring an Associate Business Consultant – CRM & Marketing Automation to join our Hyderabad team.
  
  
This is a client-facing business consulting and solution implementation role, not a conventional IT Business Analyst or documentation-focused position.
  
  
You will work directly with customers to understand their sales, marketing, and customer engagement challenges and help translate their business needs into practical CRM and marketing automation solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be comfortable interacting with clients, asking insightful questions, presenting ideas confidently, and collaborating with technology teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Consulting & Client Engagement
  
  
- Engage directly with clients to understand their sales, marketing, and customer engagement processes.
  
- Conduct discovery sessions, requirement workshops, and business process discussions.
  
- Identify opportunities to improve lead generation, sales conversion, customer retention, and campaign effectiveness.
  
- Translate business challenges into functional requirements and practical solution recommendations.
  
  
CRM & Marketing Automation
  
  
- Understand and help configure sales pipelines, lead management, customer journeys, and CRM workflows.
  
- Work with marketing automation capabilities including email, WhatsApp, social media, and multichannel campaigns.
  
- Help customers define marketing goals, campaign KPIs, lead qualification criteria, and conversion metrics.
  
- Assist with customer segmentation, campaign planning, and workflow automation.
  
- Support the implementation and adoption of DigiCRM across customer organizations.
  
  
Product Demonstrations & Solution Delivery
  
  
- Conduct product demonstrations and presentations for prospective and existing customers.
  
- Collaborate with product, development, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into working solutions.
  
- Support user acceptance testing, customer training, and implementation activities.
  
- Gather customer feedback and contribute to continuous product improvement.
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- 1–3 years of professional experience in digital marketing, B2C marketing, CRM, sales operations, marketing automation, or customer engagement.
  
- At least 1 year of practical exposure to B2C sales or marketing processes.
  
- Good understanding of digital marketing concepts, sales funnels, lead generation, campaign management, and customer journeys.
  
- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  
- Strong presentation skills and confidence in client-facing discussions.
  
- Ability to understand business problems, ask relevant questions, and propose logical solutions.
  
- Willingness to learn new enterprise software platforms and business processes.
  
- Comfortable working from our Hyderabad office.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
- Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or similar applications.
  
- Exposure to marketing automation tools, email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns, or customer engagement platforms.
  
- Familiarity with Google Analytics, website conversion tracking, lead attribution, or campaign performance reporting.
  
- Understanding of AI-driven marketing, workflow automation, and customer analytics.
  
- Educational background in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related disciplines.
  
  
What We Value
  
  
We value attitude, communication, business understanding, and curiosity more than technical qualifications or job titles.
  
  
You do not need to be a programmer.
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who:
  
  
- Enjoy interacting with people and understanding business challenges.
  
- Can confidently communicate ideas to business stakeholders.
  
- Have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  
- Are proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn.
  
- Aspire to build a career in business consulting and enterprise technology.
  
  
Why Join DigiDelight?
  
  
- Work directly with business customers and understand real-world challenges.
  
- Gain hands-on experience in CRM, marketing automation, and enterprise software.
  
- Develop client consulting, presentation, and solution design skills.
  
- Work closely with product and business leadership teams.
  
- Build a career in a growing enterprise technology company with opportunities for greater responsibility.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates can email their updated CV to:
  
  
rajani.chiluka@digidelight.com
  
  
Email Subject: Associate Business Consultant – DigiCRM
  
  
Please include a brief introduction describing your experience in marketing, CRM, or customer engagement and why this opportunity interests you.
  
  
We are actively reviewing applications and looking to fill this position at the earliest.

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
**Description**
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.

description:

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic commercial analytics professional to join our life sciences team, supporting
**US-based pharmaceutical and biotech clients**

**extensive experience in leading both quantitative primary market research (PMR) projects (ATUs, Conjoint analysis)**

* Proven leadership and project management experience in life sciences consulting, with a strong track record of delivering strategic insights.

* Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to present complex data and insights to senior stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Strategic and client-centric mindset with therapeutic area-specific expertise.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences (e.g., pharmacology, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences); MBA preferred.
* 4+ years of experience in life sciences commercial strategy consulting, with exposure to US clients and regulatory environments.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and executing primary market research (quantitative and qualitative) and engaging with stakeholders such as HCPs, KOLs, and payers.
* Technical proficiency in Python, SQL, or other analytics platforms to support data-driven decision-making.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to lead projects and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
* Personal drive, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

* Extensive experience in commercial strategy projects including market uptake studies, opportunity assessments, market entry strategies, ATU studies, product messaging strategies, TPP research and conjoint analysis
* Ability to proactively manage tasks and contribute to strategic problem-solving.
* Experience working across diverse therapy areas such as oncology, immunology, rare diseases, and cardiovascular.
* Collaborative mindset with a strong work ethic and ability to thrive in demanding situations.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Pricing Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert, accountable for supporting growth across deals and analyzes deals to find efficiencies and ensure lower costs and maximum profitability.
  
  
This role participates in pre-sales engagements to support the qualification of deals with a particular focus on the pricing and margin aspects of the pursuit.
  
  
The Pricing Analyst provides input on any complex deal review process related to deals in their assigned area of responsibility.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Provides an analytical breakdown of pricing structures.
* Maintains familiarity with hardware / software licensing and services commercial model in the vendor’s environment.
* Ensures costing optimization with the vendors and regions and work with the Sales team to optimize deals, mitigate risks for the organization and prevent potential channel or country/region conflicts.
* Work across multiple teams to implement pricing and deal packaging guidelines.
* Analyzes data from a variety of sources and using it to derive insights into pricing strategies and market trends.
* Supports with designing competitive pricing proposition of specific client deals.
* Supports deal structuring and/or packaging guidance to Sales, incorporating macro perspective into deal guidance in order to ensure that deals make overall business sense (precedent setting, pricing/discounts across segments/geographies and product family, hardware and software discounts).
* Creates pricing tools that are used to more quickly respond to changing market needs or trends.

* Performs scenario analysis, what if comparisons, sensitivity analysis, on key deal during deal structuring cycle.

* Provides analysis identifying common trends and issues around pricing and competitive situations, learnings from deals, pricing pressures, competitive pressures, loopholes, etc., encountered in day-to-day management of the region.
* Accountable for capturing knowledge into artefacts that can be used to support new pursuits and ensure it is embedded in company's overall approach– e.g. updated costing and pricing policies, models.

title: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)
description:
**Job Description: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Much of Bilvantis growth runs through the CEO's relationships, with clients, prospects, partners and the wider network. The ideas are there: who to reach, how to engage, what to send and when. What's missing is someone who makes sure every one of those threads is researched, followed up and moved forward, every time.
  
  
This role is the CEO's growth shadow. You'll own the rhythm behind every contact, lead, opportunity and meeting, so that nothing slips, the right content reaches the right person at the right time, and every meeting, trip and event turns into real progress.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Pipeline and relationship nurturing:**

* Keep every contact, lead and opportunity the CEO is working on in one place (CRM), each with a clear status, next step and date.
* Run a planned nurture calendar for each relationship, with the right touchpoint at the right time: case studies, articles, newsletters, event invites and updates.
* Draft follow-ups in the CEO’s voice within 24 hours of every interaction, ready to review and send.
* Hold a Daily connect and weekly pipeline review with the CEO: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs the CEO personally.

**Research And Prospect Building**

* Turn the CEO’s ideas on industries, accounts and people into researched target lists and account maps.
* Prepare a short brief before every meeting or outreach: the person, the company, their priorities, recent news, the Bilvantis angle and talking points.
* Track buying signals such as leadership changes, funding, migration plans and partner activity, and flag the right moments to engage.

**Meetings And Action Closure**

* Join all external meetings and growth-related internal meetings (pipeline, account reviews, leadership reviews), virtually by default.
* Capture notes, decisions and actions, and send a clear summary with owners and dates soon after each meeting.
* Follow every action through to completion with internal and external stakeholders, and escalate early when something is at risk.

**Content And Internal Coordination**

* Work with Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales, Solutions and Marketing to get the right decks, proposals, case studies and updates ready on time.
* Check quality and fit before anything goes to an external contact, so every piece we send is relevant, accurate and on-brand.
* Keep a ready library of content for each industry, solution and partner.

**Travel And Event Planning**

* Plan the CEO’s travel and events around people, clients, partners and growth priorities: which city, which week and who to meet.
* Secure meetings before each trip, build the itinerary, and prepare a brief for every person the CEO will meet.
* Close every trip and event with follow-ups within 48 hours and a short summary of outcomes and next steps.
* Work with the admin or travel desk on logistics; your focus is the purpose and outcomes of each trip.

**Partner And Network Follow-through**

* Support follow-ups with Databricks and Google Cloud partner teams, event contacts, referral partners and advisors.

**Working Hours And Travel**

* Based in Hyderabad, working fixed overlap hours with the US (Central Time), for example 6 pm to 1 am IST or a split shift.
* Travel with the CEO on key US trips and on all India trips; a valid US B1/B2 visa, or willingness to obtain one, is required.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 5+ years to 10 years in business development, client engagement, consulting or a founder’s / CEO’s office.
* Highly organized and dependable: you keep many threads moving at once and never drop one.
* Strong writing: clear, crisp emails, LinkedIn messages, briefs and meeting summaries, and the ability to write in the CEO’s voice.
* Business sense: enough understanding of Data, AI, cloud and our solutions to choose the right content and message for each person.
* Getting things done without authority: you get busy internal teams to deliver on time, politely and persistently.
* Research skills: quick, sharp research on companies and people using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and the web.
* Communication and presence: confident with senior leaders, both internal and external, in the US and India.
* Discretion and judgement: you work closely with the CEO and senior contacts, and handle confidential information with care.
* Comfortable with tools: CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), Microsoft 365, Sales Navigator, and AI tools for research, notes and drafting.
* Ownership: you act as if the pipeline is yours, not like an assistant waiting for instructions.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in a founder’s office, CEO’s office or chief of staff role.
* Background in IT services, consulting or Data & AI.
* Experience working with US clients and time zones.
* An MBA or equivalent business qualification.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Every active contact and opportunity has a current status and next step; nothing goes stale.
* Follow-ups sent within 24 hours of meetings and within 48 hours of trips and events.
* Meeting actions closed on time, across internal and external stakeholders.
* Growth in qualified meetings and opportunities from the CEO’s network and nurture programmes.
* Measurable outcomes from each trip and event, such as meetings held, opportunities opened and relationships advanced.
* CEO time saved and redirected to high-value conversations.

**Why Join**

* Work directly alongside the CEO and see how a fast-growing company is built from the inside.
* Real exposure to senior clients, partners and leadership in the US, India, the UK and the UAE.
* A role that can grow into chief of staff, strategy or BD leadership.

title: Senior Consulting Manager - AOC / UOC
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**The Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Consulting Manager – AVEVA Operations Control**
to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in AVEVA Operations Control, AVEVA System Platform, Historian, Operations Management Interface (OMI), Reports, and enterprise industrial system architectures, along with a strong understanding of OT-IT convergence, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and enterprise integration.
  
  
The role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the entire project lifecycle—from solution consulting and architecture through engineering, deployment, testing, commissioning, and production support. The successful candidate will establish technical standards, drive architecture governance, and ensure solutions align with customer business objectives, industry best practices, and organizational quality standards.
  
  
In addition to technical leadership, this role includes people management responsibilities, providing mentorship, coaching, and career development for a team of solution architects, technical leads, and engineers. As a trusted technical advisor, the Solution Architect will collaborate closely with customers, business stakeholders, project managers, delivery teams, and cross-functional engineering groups to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable industrial digital transformation solutions across industries including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Power, Utilities, Water, and Infrastructure. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration while ensuring successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio.
* Define scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures that align with customer business objectives, enterprise IT standards, and OT operational requirements.
* Prepare, review, and maintain Solution Design Documents (SDD), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Detailed Design specifications (DDS), Solution architecture, System Architecture, Factory Acceptance Test Procedure, Site Acceptance Test Procedures and deployment documentation.

* Design and govern deployment architectures for the complete AVEVA Operations Control ecosystem, including:

+ AVEVA System Platform
+ AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
+ AVEVA Historian
+ AVEVA Identity Manager
+ Galaxy Repository
+ Application Object Servers
+ Alarm Servers
+ Communication Drivers
+ License Manager
+ Microsoft SQL Server
+ IIS Web Servers

* Architect High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, backup, and failover strategies to ensure maximum system availability and business continuity.
* Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and mission-critical deployments across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments.
* Define enterprise system architecture, network topology, server infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, communication protocols, and integration patterns, customer standards, and AVEVA best practices.
* Design secure authentication and authorization solutions leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, HTTPS/TLS, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Review and approve technical designs, engineering deliverables, and deployment strategies to ensure architectural consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines, and technical governance processes across projects.
* Evaluate new AVEVA product capabilities and emerging technologies to continuously improve solution architecture, standardization, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify technical risks, perform architecture reviews, and define mitigation strategies to ensure successful project execution.
* Ensure all solution designs comply with AVEVA recommended practices, cybersecurity requirements, organizational governance, regulatory standards, and project-specific performance, availability, and reliability objectives.

**Essential Requirements**
**Non-Technical:**

* Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, executive stakeholders, project teams, and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, coaching, and people management skills with experience in developing high-performing technical teams.
* Proven ability to lead customer workshops, architecture reviews, technical governance meetings, and executive presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex technical challenges.
* Experience in effort estimation, resource planning, risk management, and technical governance across multiple concurrent projects.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, architecture workshops, solution reviews, commissioning support, and project delivery activities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Visio, and Microsoft Project.

**Technical**

* 18+ years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, MES, or Digital Manufacturing, with at least 10 years in Solution Architecture or Technical Leadership roles.

- Extensive expertise in the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio, including:

* AVEVA System Platform
* AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
* AVEVA Historian
* AVEVA Identity Manager
* AVEVA Communication Drivers
* AVEVA License Manager
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AVEVA Operations Control solutions for mission-critical industrial environments.
* Strong expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available industrial architectures for on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), failover strategies, and system performance optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Experience designing secure architectures utilizing HTTPS/TLS, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and cybersecurity best practices
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence and enterprise integration with systems such as SAP, IBM Maximo, Microsoft applications, RESTful APIs, OPC DA/UA, MQTT, and other industrial communication protocols.
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures involving AVEVA Historian, SQL Server, reporting platforms, and analytics solutions.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including Virtual Machines, networking, storage, identity management, and hybrid deployment architectures.
* Experience establishing architecture standards, engineering guidelines, reusable frameworks, and governance processes across multiple projects.
* Proven ability to perform technical reviews, solution validation, architecture governance, and design assurance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, production deployment, operational readiness, and support transition.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete project lifecycle, from solution consulting and architecture to implementation, commissioning, and production support.
* Experience with AVEVA CONNECT, Industrial IoT, Digital Transformation initiatives, and cloud-based industrial solutions is desirable.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, containerization, and DevOps practices is considered an advantage.
* Experience mentoring Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within engineering organizations.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

title: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)
description:
**Job Description: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
At Bilvantis, growth comes from going deep in each account. The Client Partner owns that. You'll treat your accounts like a business you run: you deepen the relationships we have, open new ones, and keep finding where Bilvantis can create real value for the client. When that works, the account grows.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Account growth:**

* Own the revenue, margin and growth targets for your accounts, and build and run an account plan for each one.
* Find ways to upsell and cross-sell, from new projects and expanded scope to new service lines and our accelerators.
* Co-sell with partners such as Databricks and other technology alliances.
* Keep the pipeline and forecast accurate, and lead proposals from first idea through to signed contract.

**Relationships**

* Build trusted relationships at several levels of the client: executive sponsors, business leaders, technology heads and procurement.
* Move beyond the people we already know and build new relationships across business units and regions.
* Hold the governance cadence: QBRs, steering committees and executive check-ins.

**Mapping Client Needs To What Bilvantis Offers**

* Know the client deeply: their business, priorities, technology landscape, budget cycles, politics and competitors.
* Know Bilvantis just as well: our solutions, accelerators, case studies and people.
* Connect the two by spotting where we can create value before the client asks, and turning that into a clear story they'll fund.

**Working With Internal Teams**

* Act as the link between the client and the Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales and Solutions teams.
* Take our existing solutions and people to the client, so they're positioned, staffed and land well.
* Bring client needs and feedback back to the team, and work with them to shape new solutions and offerings.

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization
description:
**Summary**
Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Insights and Analytics, the Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization is accountable for developing enterprise and cross-portfolio investment/resource optimization recommendations in partnership with Finance across US direct external spend, capability spend, and HQ and field FTEs.
  
  
The role serves as a Hyderabad capability anchor for EH Enterprise Resource Optimization, providing analytical depth, scenario evaluation, external benchmarking, synthesis and recommendation development in partnership with US-based Enterprise I&A and Finance stakeholders.
  
  
Working in a two-in-a-box model with the AIDE Analytics, Capabilities & Modeling CoE, the role defines business questions, frames analytical requirements, challenges assumptions and translates optimization-model outputs into clear, actionable investment recommendations.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Enterprise Investment Optimization**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
**Enterprise Investment Optimization Recommendations**

* Structure ambiguous investment and resource-allocation questions into clear decision problems, scenarios, evaluation criteria, and executive-ready recommendations across direct spend, capability spend, HQ, and field FTE resourcing for the US portfolio.
* Support EH in developing prioritized guidance on where, how, and when to reallocate or invest by synthesizing optimization outputs, external benchmarks, financial ratios, analogs, risks, trade-offs, and expected outcomes into clear recommendations for USLT.
* Build and maintain external benchmarking to assess Novartis investment levels versus comparable players, identify potential overinvestment or reallocation opportunities, and challenge historical budget baselines to enable more optimal investment decisions.

**Partnership with the Modeling CoE**

* Partner closely with the AIDE CoE Modeling sleeve to deliver integrated enterprise-level investment recommendations, ensuring consultation and modeling operate as one connected capability from the stakeholder perspective.
* Lead the consultation side of the two-in-a-box model by defining business questions, framing modeling requirements, stress-testing methodologies and assumptions, and validating that outputs are fit for the decision at hand.
* Align with Analytics and Modeling leadership on clear handoffs, decision rights, and ways of working to ensure seamless delivery and accountability.

**Finance & Enterprise Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with Finance to co-create enterprise investment and resourcing recommendations by aligning financial baselines, assumptions, decision frameworks, and I&A evidence into clear guidance on investment choices, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Support enterprise planning and executive review forums with decision-ready investment-optimization recommendations, while resolving interfaces with adjacent teams across AIDE, SPT, and Finance and escalating unresolved ownership questions with a recommended position.
* Maintain clear role boundaries, ensuring the function provides strategic advisory recommendations without holding final budget or workforce allocation authority.

**Enterprise Standards & Capability Building**

* Apply and continuously improve enterprise standards and methodologies for producing, framing, and communicating resource optimization guidance across direct spend, capability spend, and HQ and field FTEs.
* Build the team’s consultative capability by strengthening strategic advisory skills that translate analytical outputs into clear business recommendations.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare resource allocation, investment optimization, commercial analytics, strategic finance, or management consulting, with strong quantitative fluency and strategic consulting capability.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field required, MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Proven ability to translate optimization model outputs into actionable investment recommendations for senior business and finance leaders, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, identify limitations, and assess methodology without directly building the model.
* Working knowledge of marketing mix, promotion response, investment optimization, external benchmarking, financial ratios, and analogs to inform resource allocation and investment guidance.
* Experience partnering with Finance on budget, investment, or headcount planning, with people management experience and exposure to globally distributed delivery models.

**Required Skills**

* Strong strategic consulting and business acumen, with the ability to structure ambiguous investment questions, understand pharmaceutical commercial investment dynamics, and develop clear, defensible recommendations.
* Quantitative fluency to critically interpret model results, challenge methodologies and assumptions, and distinguish signal from noise in ambiguous or incomplete evidence environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present persuasive investment recommendations to senior leaders and influence without authority in a two-in-a-box model.
* Proficiency with Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

**Preferred Experience And Skills**

* Management consulting experience at a top-tier firm or comparable internal strategy role, with exposure to large-scale transformation, operating model redesign, offshore analytics/modeling hubs, and portfolio-level investment prioritization.
* Experience across multiple spend categories, including promotional, capability/capital, workforce resourcing, and launch resourcing.
* Working knowledge of the US pharmaceutical commercial model, data, and analytics ecosystem, with familiarity in AI-enabled investment analysis, scenario modeling, and process modernization.
* Strong change management and stakeholder communication skills.

**Location:**
Hyderabad NKC | Hybrid | 3 days a week in office is mandatory.

Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

description:

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. * Engage business sponsors, product owners, Enterprise Architects, Security, and Operations leaders to frame outcomes and define the target agentic scenarios.
* Assess customer AI readiness across identity, data, security/compliance, and operating model; identify gaps to unlock Copilot and agent adoption at scale.
* Identify industry and technology trends including AI adoption patterns, Low‑Code modernization, Copilot usage, GitHub Copilot assisted development, and data readiness to influence solution architecture direction.
* Translate business requirements into end-to-end solution options across Power Platform, Azure, and Microsoft 365 Copilot/Copilot Studio extensibility.
* Socialize solution approaches with customers, validating feasibility, operating impact, scalability, and change management required for Copilot and agent rollouts.
* Maintain an iterative feedback loop with Product Engineering and internal communities to relay field insights that shape M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform capabilities for agentic engagements.
* Partner with account and delivery teams to shape the solution play, refine estimates, adjust pre‑sales solution components, govern scope changes, and position technical risks for agentic AI adoption.

**Architecture Design and Deployment**

* Apply structured delivery methodologies (Agile/Iterative/Hybrid) and reference architectures to design scalable Copilot and agentic solutions.
* Own and maintain architectural documentation, including agent design specs, integration contracts, and operational runbooks.
* Define and communicate end-to-end architecture with traceability from business outcomes to agent behaviors, tools, data grounding, quality attributes, and compliance controls.
* Lead cost- and technology-based discussions to assess feasibility, deployment options (cloud/edge), scale, and customer appetite for agentic innovation.
* Apply business value principles prioritizing ROI, productivity, adoption/usage intensity, and long-term operational efficiency.
* Partner with the Project Manager to drive governance across design, build, testing, deployment, pilots, and scale-out of Copilot and agent capabilities.
* Validate delivered business value (revenue enablement, productivity uplift, customer/employee experience improvement, cost savings) and connect outcomes to telemetry and adoption signals.
* Direct development and execution of test strategies (functional, security, privacy, and AI evaluations) to prove requirement compliance and support remediation and sign-off.
* Collaborate with bid teams to prepare costed, traceable solution approaches with trade-offs, AI risk posture, and clear positions on responsible AI.
* Lead implementation with the Project Manager, establishing quality standards, release planning, and operational transition for agentic workloads.
* Highlight invalidated assumptions and drive refinements through structured change control and continuous learning from production usage.

**AI, Copilot, LowCode, and Agent Extensibility**

* Establish enterprise-grade architecture to support scaled Copilot and agent deployments.
* Design Copilot extensibility solutions with secure data access patterns and clear user/agent experience flows.
* Use Copilot Studio to build and manage agents (topics/actions, orchestration, channels, monitoring) for customer productivity improvement and business process transformation.
* Apply GitHub Copilot to accelerate engineering, enforce secure coding and quality, and improve delivery velocity for agentic solutions.

**Practice Development**

* Continuously evaluate and evolve architectural approaches based on field learnings, product roadmap, and responsible AI guidance to maintain a high quality IP portfolio.
* Drive reuse of IP across pre-sales and delivery to accelerate pipeline, improve quality, and standardize agentic delivery practices. Drive reuse of IP across pre‑sales and delivery engagements.
* Contribute to internal and external Microsoft professional communities by sharing patterns, learnings, and reusable agent/Copilot assets.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Build strong networks and influence across customer and internal teams to remove barriers and accelerate Copilot and agent adoption.
* Stay current on Microsoft’s AI Business Solutions strategy and communicate platform direction across M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Act as the technical conscience balancing customer expectations with feasibility, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

**Thought Leadership**

* Share insights, reusable patterns, and strategic guidance for Copilot and agentic architectures across global communities.
* Mentor technical talent on agentic design patterns, Power Platform governance, Copilot extensibility, and responsible AI engineering.

**PreSales**

* Discover customer priorities and pain points to shape Copilot and agentic solution plays that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Propose architectures and roadmaps with clear assumptions for data readiness, identity/permissions, integrations, and AI risk controls.
* Support Sales teams in winning and expanding enterprise engagements by leading with Copilot and Agents as the transformation entry point.
* Own technical estimates and delivery approach for agentic engagements using proven, experience‑based estimation methods and reusable accelerators.

**Solution Delivery**

* Guide Low‑Code / No‑Code AI adoption across Power Platform and Copilot-‑enabled development to accelerate business process transformation.
* Lead governance and deployment of Copilot Studio agents ensuring security, responsible AI, connector controls, and data boundary alignment.
* Deliver custom Microsoft 365 Copilot extensions using approved SDKs, plugins/connectors, automation frameworks, and secure data access patterns.
* Apply engineering excellence and DevOps practices (CI/CD, quality gates, automation, observability) using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Guide sprint/iteration planning, dependency mapping, and end‑to‑end release alignment to move from pilots to scaled production adoption.

**Quality Assurance**

* Review solutions for requirement fidelity, security/privacy posture, responsible AI compliance technical quality, best‑practice alignment, and operational readiness
* Provide advisory guidance for Copilot and agent architecture, design, and delivery execution.
* Enforce best practices for Copilot Studio agent lifecycle management, grounding strategies, evaluations, and monitoring for continuous improvement .

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains (e.g., Security).

OR
  
  

* Master’s degree in related field AND 12+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains.

OR
  
  
Equivalent experience.
  
  

* Experience with a Global Systems Integrator, IT Vendor, or Microsoft Partner delivering enterprise‑scale Microsoft Business Applications.
* Strong hands‑on background in Business Applications and CRM solution delivery across medium to large enterprises.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
EndtoEnd IT / Low Code Business Applications Delivery
  
  

* Expertise across the full lifecycle of IT Solutions Delivery: Estimation, Proposal Development, Requirements, Business Process Modelling, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Operations.
* Proven delivery experience on Power Platform, M365, Copilot Studio solutions across industries.
* Experience building or extending solutions using M365 Copilot and hands on Copilot Studio expertise.
* Proficiency using GitHub Copilot or similar tools to accelerate solution development, improve engineering productivity, maintain coding standards, and support modern DevOps workflows.

Architecture, Design & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Strong capability in Low Code architecture covering:
* Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse
* Environment strategy, DLP, governance frameworks
* ALM and solution structuring
* Enterprise maturity model implementation
* Handson experience implementing and leading architecture & solution design efforts in one or more of the following:
* Power Platform (Apps, Automate, Pages, Dataverse)
* M365 extensibility and Copilotenabled experiences
* Low Code AI Solutions based on Copilot Studio or similar solutions
* Azure integrations, Logic Apps, Functions, API Management
* Security, Compliance, Identity, and Responsible AI
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority across global, multigeography delivery models.
