description:
**Meet Our Team**
Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.
  
  
**Picture Yourself At Pega**
Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.
  
  
At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**

* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.
* Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

**Who You Are**

* Pega CLSA Certified resource must.
* You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
* Experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders
* Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  
  
You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You've Accomplished**

* You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.
* You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.
* You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.
* You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologies

**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

title: Advisor, Client Solutions - CUS Q1 FY27
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Client & User Support is an industry-leading and award-winning client service team starting in Hyderabad, focusing on people with a specialized knowledge of a select group of sophisticated software and product offerings. Initially, advisors will be tasked with supporting a wide-variety of clients using the FactSet workstation, which will give the advantage of gaining knowledge and experience working with the different products clients use to obtain and analyze financial information. The team is composed of self-motivated individuals who thrive in a highly collaborative environment and enjoy the challenge of independence, responsibility, and problem solving.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Answer client questions globally through expert telephone, email, instant message, and proprietary communication channels
* Support FactSet applications
* Create custom FactSet models and screens
* Solve complex financial queries
* A proficient understanding of the FactSet Workstation, the content clients consume through FactSet, and Microsoft Excel
* Follow procedures for maintaining the highest level of quality support for all FactSet clients
* Share ideas and promote suggestions for improvement of workflows
* Cooperate and liaise with other FactSet groups, including Client Solutions, Sales, and Product Development
* Meet targets and goals set by exhibiting motivation and high performance
* Attend internal meetings and training sessions and complete projects as requested
* Keep up to date with the market we are operating in, including our products and competitors
* Progress is reviewed informally on a monthly basis, followed by formal 6 month and yearly reviews as per FactSet procedure
* All FactSet policies can be found on-line at MyRewards@FactSet
* It is the employee’s responsibility to keep updated with any changes made to them

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA Finance (Freshers and Experienced) / B.Com or M.Com or BBA Finance (only if Experienced)
* English spoken fluently
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as experience in advanced web searching
* Highly organized
* Genuine interest or experience in financial markets
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Hardworking and proactive
* Ability to work independently using creative thinking without extensive direction
* Strong work ethic and highly self-motivated
* Positive team player attitude
* Willingness to work in U.S. shifts
* Job Location: Hyderabad

**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Company Overview**
Learn more about our benefits here.
  
  
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Key Account Manager - Hyderabad
description:
We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Sales Executive to drive the growth of our High-Performance Personal Protective Equipment (HPPE) business within the assigned territory. The role focuses on developing key customer accounts, expanding channel partnerships, creating demand at the end-user level, and achieving sales targets. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen market presence and deliver business growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Candidate to be responsible for the business development and growth of the Safety Products business in HPPE.
* He will be responsible for HPPE Sales and will report the Regional Sales Leader.
* He will be responsible to create the pull for the HPPE products from the end customer level and will also be responsible for driving the channel sales and ensure their commitment towards the HPPE business.
* Will be responsible for the growth of the business as per the organization expectations.
* Will be responsible to increase the awareness in Safety products in his territory with end customers and with the channel.
* The candidate will be directly responsible for 50 key accounts in his territory and will drive the business in these accounts by himself.
* He will be a cross functional team player - who will work with the PM's, Customer Service team and PSM's.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering / Science graduate will be preferred
* Good communication and presentation skills
* The candidate must have a minimum of 5-7 years of relevant territory and selling PPE’s experience would be advantageous.

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
TruColors, founded in 2022, designs, manufactures, and markets school-wear merchandise under the brand name Prepster. The company focuses on creating high-quality, contemporary uniform and school-wear options for educational institutions and students. Team members can expect an environment that offers challenging, varied work and opportunities to contribute to a growing brand. TruColors encourages individuals who enjoy dynamic roles and are motivated to support the company’s expansion in the school-wear market.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Hyderabad. The Salesperson will engage with schools, institutions, and retail partners to promote Prepster products, manage the sales cycle, and build long-term customer relationships. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying new prospects, conducting product presentations, following up on leads, negotiating pricing and terms within company guidelines, and closing sales. The role also involves maintaining accurate sales records, coordinating with the production and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries, and gathering market feedback to support product improvements. The Salesperson will work closely with management to meet sales targets and contribute to strategic growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills, with the ability to convert leads into repeat business.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations, explain features and benefits clearly, and tailor sales pitches to different stakeholders.
* Competence in basic business communication, including email, phone, and in-person interactions, with clear spoken and written English.
* Comfort with using spreadsheets, CRM tools, or other sales tracking software to maintain records and report on performance.
* Prior experience in apparel, uniforms, retail, or related sectors is beneficial, especially in B2B or institutional sales.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel locally within Hyderabad and surrounding areas for client meetings and site visits.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Principal Architect - Apps & AI
description:

Microsoft Industry Solutions – Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a compelling opportunity for senior technical leaders to drive enterprise scale transformation through consulting, architecture, and delivery leadership.
  
  
The Principal Architect is a senior technical and business leader accountable for shaping, influencing, and driving successful outcomes across large, complex, multiyear enterprise engagements. This role operates at the convergence of technology, business strategy, and executive decision making, acting as a trusted advisor to customer CEO, CIO, CTO, and CDO stakeholders.
  
  
In the AI first GCID organization, Principal Architects lead the adoption of AI native, cloud first, and platform driven execution models at enterprise scale—ensuring solutions are not only technically sound but strategically aligned with customer business transformation goals.

AI First Enterprise Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own and drive enterprise scale architecture and delivery execution across highly complex customer portfolios, ensuring alignment to business strategy, transformation goals, and long term technology roadmaps.
* Embed AI first and AI native principles across solution design, delivery models, and operating frameworks—driving intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and data driven execution at scale.
* Serve as the primary executive technical interface for CIO / CTO / CDO leadership, translating business strategy into scalable architecture, delivery plans, and transformation milestones.
* Lead strategic recovery and stabilization of high risk or mission critical programs, establishing executive credibility and clear, outcome driven remediation paths.
* Influence architectural direction beyond a single program—shaping account level, industry level, and GCID wide technical strategies.

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies, AI platforms, and engineering paradigms to inform strategic investments and differentiated offerings.
* Influence innovation across GCID by sharing best practices, defining reusable assets, and mentoring senior architects.

This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.

* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings

**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

* Business research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI [1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time-to-market, and fab efficiency.
* Familiarity with architectural innovation, heterogeneous compute. (CPU/GPU/NPU/memory/interconnects), chiplet-based designs, co-packaged optics, advanced chip packaging and their role in performance and cost curves.
* Awareness about strategic chokepoints and importance of supply chain resilience for hardware and semiconductor components; Geopolitical and operational risks in this space.
* Consumer and end-user needs and attitudes towards AI and agent-powered devices and applications for work, education, and personal reasons – including AI at the edge.

* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
**About SmartWinnr**

 

SmartWinnr is an enterprise-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.

**Job Role:**

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad (On-site)

**About the role**

SmartWinnr is looking for a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between customer business requirements and our product capabilities. This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, along with strong expertise in sales documentation and proposal development.

You will work closely with the sales team to demonstrate SmartWinnr's platform to prospective customers, including senior leadership, understand their requirements, and prepare compelling proposals, commercial documents, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

The role also involves coordinating the review of customer agreements, setting up demo accounts, and creating customized presentations and other sales materials based on business discussions. We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently with enterprise customers, manage documentation accurately, and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.

**What you will own**

* **Product demonstrations and presentations.**

  Deliver engaging product demos to prospective customers, including senior leadership. Understand customer requirements and tailor demonstrations to relevant business use cases and expected outcomes.

* **Demo account setup.**

  Set up, configure, and maintain demo accounts and environments before customer meetings. Ensure the product is ready for demonstrations and aligned with the prospect's requirements

* **Proposal documentation.**

  Prepare professional proposals, solution documents, presentations, commercial proposals, and other sales-related documentation based on customer discussions and business requirements.

* **RFP/RFQ responses.**

  Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and customer questionnaires. Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information and ensure complete, high-quality submissions within deadlines.

* **MSA/NDA vetting and coordination.**

  Review customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for completeness, identify non-standard clauses or deviations, and coordinate with the Legal team and relevant stakeholders for review and approval.

* **Commercial documentation.**

  Prepare quotations, pricing summaries, commercial proposals, and supporting documents in coordination with the sales and finance teams. Ensure accuracy and alignment with approved commercial terms.

* **Sales decks and supporting materials.**

  Create and customize presentation decks, solution overviews, and other sales collateral based on business discussions, prospect requirements, and sales opportunities.

﻿

* **Cross-functional collaboration.**

  Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to gather information, validate product capabilities, address customer queries, and support deal progression.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, sales support, or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to enterprise customers and senior leadership.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain product features, use cases, and business value clearly.
* Experience preparing proposals, presentations, commercial documents, and other customer-facing sales materials.
* Ability to understand business discussions and translate customer requirements into structured documentation and compelling presentations.
* Strong attention to detail when preparing and reviewing documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other tools used for sales documentation.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate documentation within tight deadlines.
* A proactive, organized, and ownership-driven approach to work.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, or enterprise SaaS sales.
* Experience conducting software product demonstrations for enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with RFP/RFQ processes, commercial proposals, and enterprise procurement requirements.
* Exposure to MSA/NDA review and contract coordination.
* Experience with CRM platforms, proposal management tools, and document collaboration systems.
* Understanding of SaaS business models and enterprise sales cycles.

**What this role is not**

This is not purely a product demonstration or presentation role. It requires equal attention to sales documentation, commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and coordination of customer agreements.

The person will be expected to contribute hands-on to preparing documents, setting up demo accounts, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting the sales team in moving opportunities forward.

**Things worth knowing before you apply**

You will work closely with the sales team and engage with prospective enterprise customers. Strong communication, presentation skills, documentation accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple sales-related activities are essential to succeeding in this role.

The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working on-site.

title: Study Abroad Consultant
description: ## About the RoleAt Leverage Edu, we believe every student deserves the right guidance to achieve their global education aspirations. We are looking for ambitious, driven, and student-focused individuals to join our team as **Study Abroad Consultants**.As a Consultant, you will be responsible for guiding students through their study abroad journey, understanding their aspirations, recommending the right-fit universities and programmes, and helping them make informed decisions about their future. You will serve as their trusted advisor, building strong relationships and ensuring a seamless experience from the initial consultation to admission and enrolment.This role offers the opportunity to combine your communication, advisory, and relationship-building skills with a strong focus on **student outcomes, enrolment success, and business growth**. You will work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where taking ownership, building trust, and consistently delivering results are key to success.## Key Responsibilities**1. End-to-End Student Relationship Management**- Own and manage a portfolio of students throughout their study abroad journey, from the first interaction to successful admission and enrolment.- Understand students' academic backgrounds, career aspirations, budgets, and preferences to recommend suitable study abroad options.- Build strong, lasting relationships with students and their families through personalised guidance and consistent engagement.**2. Student Counselling and Solution Advisory**- Conduct in-depth consultations to understand student requirements and provide tailored recommendations on countries, universities, courses, and career pathways.- Present suitable programmes and services, clearly communicating their value and relevance to students' goals.- Help students evaluate their options, address concerns, and make confident, well-informed decisions.**3. University and Admissions Expertise**- Develop a strong understanding of international education markets, university admission processes, intake cycles, eligibility criteria, and application requirements.- Guide students on standardised tests and English language proficiency exams, including GRE, GMAT, IELTS, and TOEFL.- Stay updated on university offerings, admission trends, and emerging opportunities across study destinations.**4. Application Progress and Process Management**- Track student progress at every stage of the application journey and ensure timely completion of key milestones.- Proactively identify challenges, address concerns, and coordinate with internal teams to minimise delays.- Maintain accurate student records and ensure consistent follow-ups to keep applications moving forward.**5. Admission, Offer and Enrolment Coordination**- Guide students through offer evaluation, university selection, and subsequent admission formalities.- Collaborate with visa, admissions, finance, and international university teams to facilitate a smooth transition from offer acceptance to enrolment.- Ensure students receive timely support and a high-quality experience throughout the process.**6. Performance and Business Growth**- Take ownership of individual performance goals and contribute to the team's overall business objectives.- Convert student consultations into meaningful enrolment outcomes through effective needs assessment, solution positioning, objection handling, and relationship management.- Manage the student pipeline proactively, prioritise high-intent opportunities, and maintain consistent follow-ups to maximise outcomes.- Identify opportunities to improve student engagement, decision-making, and enrolment rates while maintaining a student-first approach.## What You Bring1. A graduate or MBA degree in business, management, psychology, or a related field.2. 0–5 years of professional experience; experience in ed-tech, education consulting, customer engagement, or client-facing roles is an advantage.3. Strong communication, influencing, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.4. A results-oriented mindset with the ability to work towards defined performance goals and deliver measurable outcomes.5. Excellent research and analytical abilities, with an interest in international education and global career opportunities.6. The ability to understand customer needs, present tailored solutions, handle objections, and build confidence through effective communication.7. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple student journeys simultaneously.8. A proactive, resilient, and ownership-driven attitude, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment.## What We Offer1. Industry-leading perks and benefits.2. A dynamic work environment with significant ownership, learning, and career growth opportunities.3. The opportunity to work alongside talented teams across technology, marketing, partnerships, content, and student experience.4. A high-performance culture that encourages initiative, accountability, continuous learning, and rapid execution.5. Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities and grow into leadership roles.6. Access to experienced mentors and a strong professional network within the international education ecosystem.7. The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping students make life-changing decisions about their higher education and careers.**Work Mode:** Full-time, office-based role **Working Days:** Six days a week

**Title: Senior Consultant, IOT Product Security**
**Work You’ll Do**
Support clients in improving cybersecurity across OT, ICS, and industrial environments. The role will involve solution design and deployment, client engagement, project delivery, proposal support, and team coordination.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Assess OT cybersecurity risks across manufacturing, industrial, utilities, energy, or similar environments.

* Contribute to proposals, client presentations, project planning, and delivery.

* 5–10 years of experience in OT, ICS, industrial cybersecurity, or a related field.

* Knowledge of OT devices and OT network architectures.

+ OT asset management
+ OT network segmentation
+ Secure remote access
+ OT monitoring or IDS
+ OT Automation solutions
+ OT incident response
+ IoT security

* Ability to work with AI copilots or agents for repeatable delivery tasks, while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field; Master's degree (MBA, M.Tech, or MS in Cybersecurity) is a plus.

* Certifications such as ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, CISM, CISA, GICSP.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Description – Key Accounts Manager
  
Company: Bijliride
  
Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Experience: Freshers – 3 years
  
Qualification: MBA must required
  
Salary: 3-4lpa
  
  
About Bijliride
  
Bijliride is a fast-growing electric mobility company providing sustainable, convenient, and cost-effective
  
electric two-wheeler rental solutions to individuals and businesses.
  
  
Our services include electric vehicle rentals, battery delivery and swapping, breakdown assistance, B2B
  
fleet rentals, 3PL solutions, and EV fleet management. We are focused on building a reliable and
  
uninterrupted mobility ecosystem for our customers and business partners.
  
  
Position Overview
  
We are looking for a Key Accounts Manager who will be responsible for managing and developing
  
relationships with key B2B clients and business partners.
  
  
The role involves understanding client requirements, ensuring smooth service delivery, coordinating with
  
internal teams, resolving client issues, and identifying opportunities for account growth and revenue
  
generation.
  
  
Freshers with an MBA who have strong communication and relationship-management skills are also
  
encouraged to apply.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
● Manage and maintain strong relationships with key B2B clients and business partners.
  
● Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
  
● Understand client requirements and ensure timely resolution of queries and concerns.
  
● Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Service, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure smooth
  
service delivery.
  
● Monitor account performance, usage, revenue, and customer satisfaction.
  
● Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, renewals, and business growth.
  
● Handle client escalations and coordinate with relevant teams for quick resolution.
  
● Maintain regular communication with clients and conduct client meetings/business reviews.
  
● Coordinate with the Finance team regarding invoicing, outstanding payments, and collections.
  
● Prepare and maintain account reports, MIS, and performance updates.
  
● Support client onboarding and ensure a smooth transition from sales to operations.
  
● Build long-term relationships and improve client retention.
  
● Proactively identify potential issues and take corrective action before they impact the client.
  
● Support business expansion by identifying additional requirements and opportunities within
  
existing accounts.
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
● MBA is preferred.
  
● Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0–5 years of experience in Key Account Management,
  
Client Servicing, Business Development, Sales, or B2B Relationship Management are eligible.
  
● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
● Strong presentation, negotiation, and client-handling abilities.
  
● Good problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  
● Ability to manage multiple clients and coordinate with different internal teams.
  
● Good working knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.
  
● Knowledge of CRM tools is an added advantage.
  
● Experience in EV, mobility, logistics, fleet management, or service industries will be an
  
advantage.
  
● Fluency in English, Hindi, and Telugu is preferred.
  
● Self-motivated, proactive, responsible, and target-oriented.
  
● Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Working Requirements
  
● This is a client-facing and operationally important role.
  
● The candidate should be comfortable handling client calls beyond regular working hours when
  
required.
  
● Availability may be required for urgent client requirements, operational escalations, or
  
time-sensitive issues.
  
● Candidates should be flexible and committed to maintaining strong client relationships and
  
uninterrupted service.
  
What We Offer
  
● Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
  
● Opportunity to work with high-value B2B clients and business partners.
  
● Exposure to the growing EV and electric mobility industry.
  
● Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organization.
  
● Hands-on experience in account management, business development, and operations.
  
● Supportive and growth-oriented work environment.
  
  
Immediate joiners are preferred.

title: Anaplan Lead
description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
Peloton is seeking an experienced Anaplan Solution Architect to play a key role in delivering connected planning solutions and supporting the growth of our Anaplan practice. This is a hands-on, client-facing role focused on designing, building, and optimizing scalable Anaplan models across Finance (FP&A), Supply Chain (S&OP), and Sales planning domains. As an Anaplan Architect, you will serve as a subject matter expert, guiding clients through transformation initiatives while ensuring best practices in model design, data integration, and overall solution architecture.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Solution Architecture & Design
  
- Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale, connected Anaplan planning solutions
  
  
- Translate complex business problems, legacy tools, and spreadsheets into scalable, multi-dimensional Anaplan models
  
  
- Define solution architecture, data flows, and model design standards aligned with Anaplan best practices
  
  
- Develop implementation roadmaps and high-level solution strategies
  
  
Requirements & Delivery Execution
  
- Gather and analyze business requirements across Finance, Supply Chain, and/or Sales planning functions
  
  
- Design, build, and optimize Anaplan models to support planning, forecasting, and reporting needs
  
  
- Enhance and extend existing models to support new functionality and evolving business requirements
  
  
- Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-go-live stabilization
  
  
Data Integration & Modeling
  
- Design and support data integration solutions (inbound and outbound) between Anaplan and source systems
  
  
- Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and performance across models and integrations
  
  
- Apply strong financial and operational modeling principles to support decision-making
  
  
Project & Team Leadership
  
- Lead project workstreams and manage team members to deliver high-quality solutions on time and within scope
  
  
- Mentor and develop team members, providing guidance on Anaplan modeling and best practices

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
