title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Salesforce Success Architect
description:
**Description**
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude**
We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
  
  

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Public Sector
* Financial Services Cloud
* Revenue Cloud & Billing
* Manufacturing Cloud
* Automotive Cloud
* Education Cloud
* Net Zero Cloud
* Non-Profit
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements**

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Desired Technical Skills**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.

**Certifications**

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

title: Technology Consultant
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with customer stakeholders to understand business workflows, constraints, and success metrics; translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, solution hypotheses, and sprint deliverables for GenAI/agentic scenarios.
* Design and implement agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, M365 Copilots, Power Platform, Azure) including integrations, APIs, and automations that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Prototype rapidly, then harden to production: build POCs for agentic workflows (multi-step tasks, tool-use, orchestration), validate with users, and evolve to production-ready implementations with testing, monitoring, and secure deployment patterns.
* Own end-to-end delivery from architecture through implementation: define build/test specifications, create eval and quality gates for GenAI outputs, and produce operational guides/runbooks for reliability, safety, and maintainability.
* Identify and mitigate business/technical risks specific to AI systems (data access, prompt injection, hallucinations, privacy, compliance, latency, cost); propose safeguards and fallback behaviors for agentic flows.
* Support deployment and live stabilization: troubleshoot integrations and model behavior in real environments, iterate quickly, and ensure successful go-live with clear ownership, monitoring, and incident playbooks.
* Balance platform configuration with extensibility to maximize speed and maintainability.
* Co-engineer with customer teams to ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, and reusable patterns. Drive delivery plans across the full lifecycle—discovery, build, eval, deployment, and operations—accounting for dependencies across data, security, and enterprise systems.
* Build agentic workflows that invoke tools/APIs safely (function calling patterns), with guardrails, validation, and auditability.
* Implement evaluation strategies (offline/online) to measure output quality, groundedness, safety, and business impact.
* Capture repeatable assets (templates, reference architectures, accelerators) and share feedback loops with internal teams.
* Microsoft 365 Migration & Security — SharePoint Server → SharePoint Online (SP–SPO), Google → Microsoft (GPC–MS). Experienced migration talent especially welcome.
* Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement — Salesforce takeouts (SF Takeout), Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), and standard CE (Sales / Customer Service / Field Service).
* Copilot Extensibility (M365 & D365) — Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, multi-agent (A2A) orchestration, Microsoft Agent Framework and governance, deep expertise in Work IQ (data, memory, inference) and APIs, enterprise data grounding via Graph/D365/connectors.
* Azure Fabric & Azure AI Foundry — One Lake-based unified data management, Lakehouse architecture for analytics and AI, model catalog usage for model discovery and fine-tuning, enterprise agent development and multi-agent orchestration via Foundry Agent Service, data grounding and RAG using One Lake and Azure AI Search.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field AND demonstrated experience delivering production software solutions (or equivalent experience).
* 15+ years’ experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions on Microsoft platforms (Dynamics 365 / M365 Copilot/ Power Platform / Azure), including integration, security, and deployment in customer environments.

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Proven experience delivering hands‑on, production-grade solutions across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirement ambiguity, development, deployment, and post‑go‑live stabilization.
* Proven delivery of Dynamics 365 CE/Power Platform solutions, M365 Copilot Solutions, plus experience building AI-infused workflows (recommendations, summarization, case routing, contact center assist, sales/service copilots) with production-grade engineering practices.
* Experience building or extending solutions involving Copilots, AI‑assisted workflows, or intelligent automation is a strong plus.
* Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.
* Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.
* Desirable experience includes Azure solution development, Contact Center solutions, Copilot Studio, and building GenAI/agentic experiences (tool-use orchestration, retrieval grounding, evaluation/quality loops, safety/guardrails).
* Excellent communication: explain AI behaviors, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders; drive alignment from ambiguity to execution.
* Trusted customer-facing engineering presence: collaborate deeply, pair-build with customer teams, and transfer knowledge to ensure long-term maintainability.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks, including AI-specific failure modes (grounding gaps, unsafe outputs, data leakage) and enterprise constraints (security, privacy, compliance).
* IC role: influence without authority through strong engineering judgment, structured problem-solving, and crisp stakeholder communication.

Comfort working across time zones and blended onsite/offshore models; thrives in fast-moving, customer-embedded delivery
  
  
**Success In This Role Includes**

* Delivers working GenAI/agentic solutions from prototype to production with measurable customer impact.
* Implements guardrails and evaluation to ensure reliability, groundedness, safety, and cost/performance targets.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in the areas of requirements and solution documentation.
* Ability to manage and work across multiple projects. Experience working with remote teams across different timezones

* Strong logical, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Open to travel on short notice to customer locations when required
* Good to have knowledge of Web Design using HTML, JavaScript
* Good understanding of MS Office, JIRA, Basecamp applications
* Ability to learn new skills and operate in a fast-paced and changing environment.
* Experience in the wellness/spa industry a plus.
* Eagerness to learn about the opportunities and challenges driving revenue in the health and wellness industry.

**Why Zenoti?**

* Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.
* Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.
* Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti’s platform.

* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.

* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. description:

Our clients span Transportation, Waste Water, Ports, High-Rise Buildings, Bridges, Tunnels, and Power Plants.

**About the Role**

RADISE India is seeking a versatile Proposal & Market Research Coordinator to join our Hyderabad team. This role blends market/bid research with proposal coordination and writing, supporting our Engineering & IT Staffing proposals for US Federal, SLED opportunities. The ideal candidate can identify and track bidding opportunities, maintain CRM data, and then carry those opportunities through to compliant, well-written, and professionally packaged proposals.

Market Research & Bid Identification

title: TC-CS-AEET-Senior-ZT
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.

* Identify requirements, design document and implement technical solutions for scalable and resilient network architecture.
* Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
* Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.

* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

title: Technical Engagement Lead
description:
The Role

You'll own a portfolio of existing client accounts, reporting to a Sr Account Manager. Your job is to run each engagement — requirements gathered, scope signed off, work delivered, the client's team trained and using it — landing on the committed date and at the quality bar the client expects, every time, while stewarding your accounts' ongoing migrations. You coordinate the analysts and a cross-functional team on each engagement without reporting lines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership, early.

This role is a designed transition: within two quarters you move into an FDE or AM seat — the landing is decided with the leadership team based on where you've demonstrated the most strength. The move is part of the role's design, not a contingency.

The Bar

Client satisfaction is the top priority for this role, achieved through delivery excellence — project management and technical quality. Every engagement lands on time and at the quality bar clients expect, the client genuinely well taken care of throughout, and the work actually put to use — and the measure is whether the client ends the engagement a promoter: someone who'd recommend Saras unprompted.

What You'll Own

1. **Land every engagement on time and at the quality bar clients expect.**
   No quietly cutting corners to hit a deadline.
2. **Run the full cycle — requirements to sign-off and adoption.**
   Gather business requirements, get explicit sign-off on scope and success criteria, deliver the work, train the client's team to actually use it, and confirm it's being used.
3. **Build a delivery sprint plan that leaves no room for ambiguity.**
   Every cross-functional team member knows exactly what success looks like for their task — ownership, success criteria, and dates that mean something.
4. **Keep the client genuinely well taken care of.**
   Clear communication, no surprises, and the hard conversations handled directly and calmly when something's off track.
5. **Coordinate the analysts and cross-functional partners on each engagement — without reporting lines.**
   Catch problems early, remove blockers before they impact deadlines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership the moment a commitment is at risk.
6. **Steward your accounts' ongoing migrations.**
   Keep them moving on schedule, and keep the client confident through them.

What Winning Looks Like

**First 90 days:**
You've picked up the delivery cadence on your accounts, you know the book and the state of every migration cold, and you know exactly where each engagement stands against its committed dates and quality bar.

**Steady state:**
Every engagement you own lands on the agreed date, at the agreed quality bar, the client can point to it being used, and your clients would recommend Saras — and by the end of quarter two you've demonstrated the strengths that decide your FDE or AM landing.

Who Thrives Here

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you've run multiple full cycles of requirements gathering, sign-off, and usage.

* You've managed technical delivery or implementation projects — data, analytics, software, or systems — from requirements through go-live, for 5+ years.
* You're comfortable working hands-on with SQL, either Tableau or Power BI, or data pipelines — enough to manage the delivery credibly and speak the team's technical language.
* You've held client conversations about scope, value, or renewals — enough commercial footing to see how delivery becomes revenue.
* You've conducted product or platform trainings directly with clients — comfortable being the face of adoption, not just the person who ships the work.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

* Hands-on experience building AI agents using tools like Claude Code to improve delivery efficiency.
* You've built production-grade dashboards as React-native web apps, using AI-assisted development.
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent project-management credential.
* Experience in pre-sales at an analytics or consulting firm (2+ years).

**Job Description**
About Us
  
  
Innovapptive is a category-defining SaaS company building the world’s most advanced AI-powered Connected Worker Platform for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by Vista Equity Partners, Innovapptive is on a mission to reimagine how industrial work gets done — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.
  
  
Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:
  
  

* Over $40 million in annual EBITDA savings at a single enterprise
* 10× frontline productivity improvements through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows
* 15–20% maintenance cost reductions and significant uptime gains across plants and sites

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:
  
  

* Named a Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar
* Featured by Gartner in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy
* Cited by LNS Research for delivering 3–5× greater value than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI

Our growth is backed by Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.
  
  
Today, with over 300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to $100M ARR within the next 3-4 years by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Innovapptive's technical team embedded directly with customers. * Working knowledge of identity, security, and network architecture in enterprise and cloud environments
* Comfortable owning technical decisions directly with customer architects and IT leadership

description:

MB Learning designs and runs educational immersion programmes for Indian schools — study trips, summer schools and learning journeys in India and abroad with partner universities. Founder-led, headquartered in Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Small team, real responsibility from day one.

**The role**

This is the senior Hyderabad role at MB Learning, combining two jobs: building relationships with schools, and making sure every programme we sell is coordinated end to end. You will meet principals, coordinators and counsellors, present our programmes, and then run the follow-through — reminders, documents, payments, parent communication and the travel team — so nothing is lost. With the Founders often travelling, you are the person who holds Hyderabad together.

**Key facts**

• Compensation: Rs 50,000 – 75,000 per month gross based on experience, plus performance incentives on programmes closed

• Type: Full-time employment · 6-month probation

• Experience: 3 – 8 years in school partnerships, admissions, counselling, education sales or programme coordination

• Location / hours: Gachibowli, Hyderabad (office-based) · Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• Start: Immediate / October 2026 · reports to the Founders

• Travel: Accompanies student groups on selected programmes in India and abroad

**What you will do**

• Build and manage relationships with schools in Hyderabad and beyond (CBSE, ICSE, IB and Cambridge): principals, coordinators, counsellors and management.

• Present MB Learning programmes in school meetings and parent sessions; take enquiries through to signed confirmations.

• Work with sales and partners: track every lead and school in the CRM, send reminders and make sure follow-ups happen on time.

• Coordinate each confirmed programme across the team — proposals, travel desk, finance, marketing — against a clear timeline.

• Chase student registrations, documents and payments with schools and parents; keep them updated before and during the trip.

• Travel with student groups on selected programmes as MB Learning’s lead on the ground; report weekly to the Founders on pipeline and collections.

**What we need from you**

• Excellent spoken and written English; confident presenting to principals and parents.

• Proven experience dealing with schools or education institutions — an existing network in Hyderabad schools is a strong advantage.

• Highly organised; follows up relentlessly and keeps several programmes moving at once.

• Able to travel with student groups for 5–10 days at a time a few times a year; based in Hyderabad.

Good to have: Study-abroad or school-excursion background · Former school coordinator or counsellor · Telugu and Hindi · Valid passport.

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn, or email admin@mblearning.in with your CV and a short note on the schools or institutions you have worked with. Subject: “Head of Institutional Partnerships & Programme Manager – [Your Name]”. Questions: +91 88888 44666.

Process: first conversation with the Founders (virtual, 30 min) → in-person round in Gachibowli (mock school pitch + coordination case) → offer. Equal-opportunity employer. We never charge a fee at any stage of hiring.

title: AI FDE Lead/Architect - Enterprise Solutions
description:
*We are looking for a True AI Forward Deployed Engineer (as coined by Palantir!) preferably with Supply Chain Domain Expertise. We are not looking for someone to run AI experiments. We are looking for someone to take AI all the way — from first conversation with a client to a system that runs in production and creates real business value.*

— 01 · THE OPPORTUNITY

AI leadership role.

Anthrobyte builds production-grade enterprise AI systems for global clients across Supply Chains & Enterprise Solutions. As we scale, we need an AI leader with Supply Chain Domain expertise who can hold the full journey: presales and discovery, solution design, consulting, and end-to-end development & deployment — all as one coherent capability.

This is less a traditional technical role and more a seat at the client table. You will work directly with the CTO, founding team, and enterprise clients to define how AI is scoped, architected, communicated, and delivered inside complex organisations. You will be the person who walks into a room with a messy problem and walks out with a solution the client believes in — and then makes it real.

**FOUNDING ROLE**

**AI Lead / Supply Chain Expertise**

Own the full AI engagement journey in Supply Chain — presales, solution design, consulting, and forward deployment — as one coherent capability.

**GROWTH TRACK · MERIT-BASED**

**Principal AI & Solutions Lead**

Grow into executive-level technical leadership — shaping company strategy, IP development, and client transformation at scale.

Requirements
  
  

**Requirements**

02 ·
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Own the solution. Drive it to production.

**Presales & Solution Design**

— Lead the pre-sales and technical discovery sessions with enterprise and mid-market clients globally — understand their pain points, data maturity, and AI readiness before anyone writes a line of code

— Own the solution design for AI proposals: use case scoping, high-level system design, data requirements, and ROI framing

— Build and present compelling PoC demos, solution blueprints, and technical proposals in partnership with the commercial team

— Respond to RFPs and RFIs with technically rigorous and commercially sharp responses that win confidence

·
**Consulting & Client Engagement**

— Act as a trusted AI advisor to client stakeholders — CXOs, VPs of Operations, IT leaders — not just a technical vendor on the call

— Run workshops, AI readiness assessments, and value stream mapping sessions at client sites and remotely

— Navigate ambiguous problem spaces and help clients articulate what they actually want to solve with AI, and why it matters

— Build long-term client relationships that translate into deepened engagements, referrals, and expanded mandates

·
**Forward Deployment & Technical Delivery**

— Be deeply involved in deployment — not just design. Understand production constraints, integration complexity, and change management realities

— Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to ensure solution designs are buildable and delivered to the quality clients expect

— Drive go-live milestones, client acceptance, and post-deployment success metrics with accountability

— Debug, iterate, and adapt: you own outcomes, not just deliverables. If something is broken, you fix it

·
**Solution Design & Thought Leadership**

— Define AI architecture patterns for the firm: LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-modal systems

— Stay ahead on applied AI research and emerging frameworks; bring relevant signals back to the team before the market does

— Mentor junior AI engineers and consultants on both client engagement craft and solution architecture rigour

— Contribute to Anthrobyte's knowledge capital — case studies, whitepapers, internal playbooks, and reusable solution accelerators

✶ The Growth Pathway

Demonstrate consistent excellence and the scope expands. You will grow into principal technical leadership — shaping company strategy, representing AI at investor and board conversations, building and leading a growing solutions team, and defining how AI transformation is delivered across every client engagement. This is not a title — it is a level of ownership that must be earned and continually re-earned.

**03 · WHO YOU ARE**

You operate across the full stack — from model architecture to client boardroom. You simplify complex problems without losing what makes them real, and you're as comfortable presenting to a VP of Supply Chain as you are reviewing a model eval report with a data science team.

You Bring

· 5+ years of hands-on AI/ML experience (LLMs, NLP, computer vision, or advanced analytics) in production

· Proven presales or solution consulting track record — you win client confidence with credibility

· Strong storytelling: complex AI concepts made accessible to business audiences, without dumbing them down

· Global client exposure (US, Europe, Middle East, or SEA) and cross-cultural fluency

· Hands-on with Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace), and cloud AI (AWS, Azure, GCP)

· Experience designing end-to-end AI systems: ingestion, pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and iteration

· Comfort in ambiguity and 0→1 environments; startup or early-stage experience preferred

Bonus Signals

Supply Chain AI · Forward Deployment · Presales / SE · LLMs & RAG · MLOps · Global Clients · IIT / IIM / Tier-1 · B2B SaaS AI · Manufacturing / Logistics

title: Growth Specialist
description:
Growth Specialist — Sales \& Partnerships
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Employment type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: Exceptional final\-year students, recent graduates and early\-career candidates are welcome to apply.
 



 About Nextrap
 



 Nextrap is an analytics\-focused wearable and health technology company being built for India. Our first product combines a screenless smart band with a companion app that helps people understand sleep, recovery, activity, heart\-rate trends and the choices that shape their health.
 



 We are not looking to build just another gadget. We want to make health data genuinely useful, beautiful and actionable.
 



 The role
 



 This is not a narrow sales role and it is not a conventional marketing internship. You will be Nextrap’s first employee, working directly with the founder to help take an early wearable brand from product to real customer love, partnerships and revenue.
 



 You will speak to customers, sell the product, build early partnerships, run growth experiments, create sharp content, and bring back the honest insights that improve the product and brand.
 



 What you will own
 


* Turn early interest into sales through thoughtful outreach, product demos, follow\-ups and customer conversations.
* Build relationships with gyms, sports clubs, coaches, athletes, wellness communities, creators and relevant B2B partners.
* Represent Nextrap at events, activations and in\-person meetings.
* Run practical growth experiments across social media, WhatsApp, communities, partnerships and offline channels.
* Help shape customer\-facing messaging, sales collateral and product demos.
* Maintain a clean lead pipeline and clearly report what customers are asking for.
* Collect customer feedback and turn it into useful product and positioning insights.
* Take ownership of the work needed to move an early\-stage company forward.



 You may be a great fit if you
 


* Communicate with clarity, energy and empathy.
* Can confidently sell both a physical product and a software experience.
* Are proactive and follow through without needing every step defined.
* Care about fitness, health, technology, design or consumer brands.
* Are comfortable with rejection, ambiguity and fast iteration.
* Can write crisp messages, make a good presentation and hold an engaging product conversation.



 We would especially love to hear from people who actively
 **play sports** 
 or have competed at a high level. First\-hand experience of training, recovery and performance gives you a real advantage in understanding the product, discovering useful insights and speaking credibly with our early customers. This is a preference, not a requirement.
 



 Prior startup, consumer\-tech, fitness, sports, campus\-community, retail, sales, creator or partnership experience is useful, but not mandatory. We care more about hunger, judgment, communication and ownership than a perfect résumé.
 



**Compensation:** 

 ₹3\.0–3\.6 LPA CTC, depending on experience, demonstrated ability and fit for the role.
 




 How to apply
 



 Send your résumé and a short note answering: How would you convince a health\-conscious Indian customer to try a screenless smart band from a new brand?
 



 Also share:
 


* One example of something you have sold, grown, organised or built—at college, work or independently.
* Your sport or fitness background, if applicable, and one health or performance insight you would want a wearable to help you understand.
* One piece of honest advice you would give Nextrap as an early\-stage wearable brand.

title: Data and AI Security Consultant
description:
**Overview**
 The EAG Security Consultant \- Data Security helps enterprise customers discover, classify, protect, govern, and investigate sensitive data across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, endpoints, cloud services, and AI\-enabled workflows. The role combines hands\-on Purview delivery, consulting judgment, regulatory awareness, and secure AI adoption patterns to reduce data exposure risk, strengthen DLP effectiveness, prepare customers for Copilot and agents, and create reusable EAG Security delivery IP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead data security discovery workshops to understand sensitive data landscape, regulatory drivers, current Purview adoption, oversharing risks, and AI / Copilot readiness blockers.
* Design and implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto\-labeling patterns, and user adoption controls.
* Configure, tune, and operationalize Data Loss Prevention across Microsoft 365 workloads, endpoints, cloud apps, browsers, and AI\-related workflows where applicable.
* Assess Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, and Compliance Manager usage to improve investigation readiness and governance maturity.
* Apply DSPM and data\-security\-for\-AI patterns to identify overshared sensitive data, label coverage gaps, exposed credentials, and risky data interactions before AI rollout.
* Support Data Protection Agents and Purview agent scenarios such as sensitive data discovery, SIT recommendation, DLP triage, Purview posture assessment, and regulatory mapping.
* Create executive\-ready deliverables including posture baselines, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, policy design packs, operating procedures, and adoption recommendations.
* Contribute reusable EAG Security IP, lab guides, demos, accelerators, playbooks, and enablement content for data security delivery at scale.


**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information protection, data loss prevention, compliance engineering, data governance, or related security consulting roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview data security capabilities, especially Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft 365 environments.
* Working knowledge of sensitive information types, classification strategies, sensitivity labels, DLP rules, alert triage, policy tuning, and exception handling.
* Ability to translate regulatory, privacy, and business requirements into implementable Microsoft Purview controls and customer\-facing design documentation.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance workloads including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoints, Defender for Cloud Apps, audit and eDiscovery signals.
* Ability to analyze policy exports, telemetry, PowerShell outputs, and Purview reports to identify coverage gaps and remediation priorities.
* Strong communication skills for technical workshops, executive readouts, project governance, and cross\-functional collaboration with security, compliance, legal, and data teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering Purview deployments for regulated customers across DLP, MIP, IRM, retention, eDiscovery, audit, or Copilot readiness scenarios.
* Exposure to Data Protection Agents, Purview posture assessment, custom SIT discovery, DLP triage agents, DSPM, DSPM for AI, or Security Copilot in Microsoft Purview.
* Ability to design custom sensitive information types, regex\-based detection logic, policy coverage assessments, and evidence\-backed compliance mappings.
* Familiarity with data security beyond Microsoft 365, including Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Dataverse, SAP, Salesforce, AWS, GCP, SaaS, or file\-server governance patterns.
* Experience creating reusable consulting IP such as discovery questionnaires, policy design templates, lab guides, dashboards, scripts, reports, and executive summaries.

description:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C\+\+, Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Eloqua \- Manager, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by implementing and configuring Oracle's suite of applications. Your role will involve managing the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization, confirming seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on delivering strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance their business processes.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. You will leverage your leadership skills to inspire your team, navigate complex situations, and deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. You are expected to embrace technology and innovation, using these tools to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and develop your personal brand. You will be instrumental in building meaningful client relationships and delivering solutions that meet their strategic needs.
   

  

**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud and enterprise marketing automation solutions.
* Experience leading multiple end\-to\-end Oracle Eloqua implementations, enhancements, integrations, and campaign transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, campaign automation, CRM integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, campaign specialists, administrators, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Marketing Automation, CRM, Lead Management, Customer Journeys, Campaign Management, Analytics, Data Integration, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of Oracle Eloqua marketing automation solutions.
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of marketing automation initiatives including demand\-generation programs, lead\-nurturing journeys, event campaigns, audience segmentation, email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and automated customer and prospect journeys.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable and reusable Eloqua solution designs and automation strategies.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops and solution\-design sessions with Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Data, Analytics, and Operations teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and marketing stakeholders and recommend appropriate campaign designs, segmentation strategies, personalization approaches, lead\-management processes, and marketing automation capabilities.
* Own technical and functional design decisions and ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data\-governance, and marketing\-technology standards.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution designs, campaign specifications, integration mappings, testing strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.

 We are looking for a technically strong Project Engineer / Sr. Project Engineer to join our Dynamic Team.
 



 The Project Engineer / Sr. Project Engineer will serve as the technical backbone of project delivery — responsible for design evaluation, techno\-commercial assessment, solution preparation, and ensuring the feasibility and viability of proposals before they advance to execution.
 



 This role demands deep domain knowledge in industrial automation and electrical systems, combined with sharp commercial awareness.
 



**Core Responsibilities** 




**A. Techno\-Commercial Evaluation \& Proposals** 



* Conduct thorough techno\-commercial evaluation of client requirements, RFQs, and tender documents.

* Prepare detailed, accurate, and competitive proposals including scope of work, BOMs, and cost estimates.
* Review and validate incoming proposals from vendors and subcontractors to ensure technical compliance and cost accuracy.

**D. Client \& Stakeholder Interaction** 



* Interact with clients to interpret their technical requirements and represent the company's technical position.
* Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and site activities as required.
* Perform quality control checks across schedules, budgets, and engineering outputs.
* Ready to Travel Internationally



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (mandatory).
* 4\- 7 years of experience in electrical/industrial automation project engineering.
* Hands\-on expertise in one or more: Substation Automation, PLC/SCADA, Protection Relays, Condition Based Monitoring Systems, Switchgear, Transformers, Motors/Generators.
* Strong experience in techno\-commercial proposal preparation and design review.
* Proficiency in engineering design and visualization software.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.



**PREFERRED BACKGROUND** 



* Experience in Oil \& Gas, Power Substations, Plants, Refineries, or similar critical infrastructure, ABB, Siemens, Schneider, GE, Toshiba etc
* Familiarity with international standards (IEC, IEEE, ANSI, NFPA).
* Knowledge of Condition Based Monitoring tools, sensors, and data\-driven asset health frameworks.

title: Architect - Infra
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.
   

  

 At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.
   

  

 Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.
   

  

 Must have a proven record of delivering business value and proven trust\-relationships with CxO, ITDM, BDM
   

  

 The job may require travel.
   

  

 Fluent English verbal and written communications skills are a must.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.
   

  

 \#GCID
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

description:

*With over 80 years as an industrial technology leader, Kennametal Inc. delivers productivity to customers through materials science, tooling and wear\-resistant solutions.  Describe the purpose of the job:
   

  

* To drive new sales and retain key accounts in the assigned territory by providing technical and field support for Tungsten Carbide wear parts used in Rotary Drilling and DTH applications within the mining industry.
* Expand Kennametal offerings beyond India by adding new customers and increasing share of wallet through successful product trials

* Manage key accounts within the assigned territory; role based in Hyderabad.
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and margin targets.
* Demonstrate strong application knowledge and technical capabilities to support customers.
* Promote Tungsten Carbide compacts for Rotary Drilling and DTH applications and manage high\-volume accounts.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities; lead negotiations and finalize long\-term contracts.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Plant, R\&D, Engineering and Finance.
* Apply industry knowledge, data analysis skills and strong account management to drive growth in a fast\-paced environment.
* Assess customer needs and develop appropriate sales strategies.
* Drive YOY sales growth and new business development within assigned accounts.
* Support team sales initiatives by sharing relevant customer and market information.
* Utilize CRM tools (MS Dynamics) for account and sales management.
* Conduct field trials, resolve customer complaints, gather competitive intelligence, and deliver product seminars/training.
* Perform complex analyses and provide recommendations to support business objectives.
* Prepare regular progress, status and forecast reports.
* Manage receivables effectively and maintain required DSO.


****Education, Work Experience, Skills, Certificates****
 Necessary to perform the job at the minimum acceptable level and preferred:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in sales, key account management, industrial sales, and wear products, including experience working with mining customers for Tungsten Carbide Compacts, PTA powders, and HF rods.
* Strong value\-selling capabilities with a winning and growth\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to understand and communicate product and technical information effectively to customers.
* Proven ability to assess customer needs, conduct trials at customer sites, and generate detailed trial reports.
* Demonstrated selling and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (over 70%).
