title: Technical Consultant-Identity & Access Management
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Technical Consultant specializing in Identity \& Access Management, you possess extensive experience and expertise in various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications. You leverage in\-depth product knowledge, client business understanding, and IAM solution expertise to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement IAM Solutions: Deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Provide Consulting Services: Analyze and resolve IAM issues and provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Advise Clients: Advise clients on the selection, implementation, customization, configuration, and production support of IAM security tools and solutions.
* Deliver End\-to\-End Solutions: Provide end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
* Resolve IAM Issues: Analyze and resolve IAM issues, contributing to an overall superior security posture for the client.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* IAM Solution Expertise: Exposure to various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications, with the ability to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
* Product Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of IAM products, including configuration, customization, and production support, to advise clients on selecting and implementing IAM security tools and solutions.
* End\-to\-End Provisioning: Experience working with end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Issue Resolution: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Client Business Understanding: Understanding of client business needs, with the ability to leverage this knowledge to deliver tailored IAM solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Downstream Application Knowledge: Exposure to various downstream applications, with the ability to integrate IAM solutions seamlessly. This includes understanding how to configure and customize these applications to meet clients' diverse business needs.
* Advanced IAM Product Suites: Experience working with multiple IAM product suites, including in\-depth knowledge of their features and capabilities. This enables providing high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' specific requirements.
* Security Posture Enhancement: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services that enhance the overall security posture for clients. This includes identifying vulnerabilities and implementing measures to mitigate risks.

title: Senior Principal NetSuite Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Minimum 10\+ years of ERP consulting experience with 7\+ years of NetSuite implementation experience, including 5\+ years leading end\-to\-end NetSuite ERP implementation projects.
   

  

* Full lifecycle NetSuite ERP implementation experience including Discovery, Solution Design, Configuration, Testing (SIT/UAT), Go\-Live, Hypercare, and Support Transition.
* Lead multiple NetSuite implementation projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced, high\-volume consulting environment.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing Functional Lead, managing executive stakeholders and driving solution governance.
* Strong understanding of NetSuite ERP, SuiteCloud platform, integrations, and Oracle implementation methodologies.
* Deep functional knowledge of Finance, SCM, CRM, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Design to Build, Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report and Lead to Quote business processes.
* Experience in at least one industry vertical and ability to recommend industry\-leading practices and scalable business solutions.
* Lead onshore/offshore functional and technical teams, providing mentoring, guidance, and delivery oversight.
* Own solution quality, project risks, scope, issue resolution, and change management throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Consultants, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful project delivery.
* Experience delivering SaaS and PaaS solutions, including third\-party integrations and ERP extensions.
* Support pre\-sales activities including solution workshops, effort estimation, RFP/RFI responses, and customer presentations.
* Contribute to practice development through reusable assets, best practices, knowledge sharing, and consultant mentoring.
* NetSuite certifications (ERP Consultant, SuiteFoundation) are highly preferred.
* CA/CPA/MBA or equivalent business qualification is an added advantage. Also must be well versed with AI tools.
* Excellent customer\-facing, presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and business writing skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, project governance, and financial management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence customer decisions, manage executive escalations, and deliver successful business outcomes.


**Responsibilities**
 As a Principal Consultant, you will be expected to own end\-to\-end project delivery, manage multiple customer engagements in parallel, provide functional leadership, mentor consulting teams, and consistently deliver successful customer outcomes aligned with Oracle quality and delivery standards.
   

  

 Principal Consultant Expectations
   

  

 As a Principal Consultant, you will own the successful delivery of multiple end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation projects while maintaining delivery excellence across quality, schedule, scope, budget, and customer satisfaction. You will act as the primary customer\-facing functional leader, providing strategic guidance throughout the engagement lifecycle and ensuring alignment with Oracle Consulting standards and industry best practices.
   

  

 The role requires balancing multiple concurrent projects in a fast\-paced, high\-volume consulting environment while effectively leading cross\-functional onshore and offshore teams, mentoring consultants, managing executive stakeholders, driving governance, mitigating delivery risks, and ensuring successful customer outcomes. In addition to project delivery, the Principal Consultant is expected to contribute to practice growth through mentoring, solution innovation, reusable assets, delivery excellence initiatives, and support for pre\-sales and business development activities.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:
**Job Description**
**JOB DATA**
 JOB TITLE: Senior Consultant
   

  

**About Intangent**
 We are North America's fastest growing Sales Performance Management consultancy. We've grown rapidly by working with the best and brightest in our industry. Our high performing consulting team and market\-leading vendor partners reflect Intangent's unwavering focus on best execution in customer experience.  Visit us at https://intangent.com/
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Xactly Consultant** 
 with a strong focus on
 **Xactly Incent** 
 and
 **Xactly Analytics** 
 to join our team. The successful candidate will lead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Xactly solutions, providing clients with cutting\-edge tools to manage their incentive compensation programs and gain data\-driven insights. This role requires deep technical expertise in Xactly’s Incentive Compensation and Analytics platforms, alongside a solid understanding of Sales Performance Management (SPM) frameworks.
   

  

**Desired Skills And Experience**
**Xactly Incent Implementation \& Configuration** 
 :
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end configuration and implementation of Xactly Incent, including designing compensation plans, setting up quotas, crediting rules, and calculating commission payouts.
* Customize Compensation Rules to reflect complex commission structures, such as tiered payouts, accelerators, draws, and recoveries, based on client\-specific business requirements.
* Configure and manage participant hierarchies, team structures, and territory assignments, ensuring accurate compensation tracking.
* Create and maintain calculation formulas, including base pay, bonuses, and multi\-variable commissions, using Xactly’s Calculation Engine.
* Handle the credit assignment process, including splitting credits between multiple participants or roles and ensuring accurate credit allocation to sales activities.
* Configure and manage Plan Documents and Participant Statements, ensuring transparency and clarity in commission reporting.
* Perform data loading and integration of various input sources (e.g., CRM data from Salesforce, ERP systems, or manual files) using Xactly's Connect integration tool.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate the functionality of the system and ensure the accuracy of calculations.
* Set up and manage dispute workflows, providing users with mechanisms to contest commissions and ensuring proper audit trails.


**Xactly Analytics And Reporting**
* Develop and configure Xactly Analytics dashboards and custom reports to provide clients with real\-time visibility into performance metrics, incentive payouts, and sales effectiveness.
* Build advanced reporting frameworks to track critical metrics, such as quota attainment, sales by product, compensation by territory, and team performance.
* Utilize Xactly Analytics' data visualization tools to design and present intuitive charts and graphs that highlight key insights for executives and sales leaders.
* Configure custom calculation logic for reporting purposes, including aggregate functions like year\-over\-year comparisons, trend analysis, and commission forecasting.
* Implement role\-based security in Xactly Analytics to ensure proper data access controls, enabling different levels of visibility for stakeholders (e.g., sales reps, managers, and executives).


**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in a software development or systems analyst role
* Must be comfortable with emerging technologies, learning new software, understanding a data model and an object model, writing SQL queries, and writing design specifications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* 3\-5 years of experience implementing Xactly Incent and Xactly Analytics.


**Technical \& Business Requirements**
* Knowledge of software development \& implementation life cycles
* Experience with major relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.)
* Proficient in Xactly Incent configuration, including:
+ Compensation Plan Design: Structuring and configuring incentive compensation plans, defining quotas, crediting rules, and payout methods.
+ Participant Management: Setting up and managing user hierarchies, teams, roles, and permissions.
+ Calculation Engine: Building custom formulas, handling complex calculation rules (e.g., weighted commissions, bonuses).
+ Plan Document Automation: Configuring automated and customizable participant statements and documents.
+ Quota Management: Configuring and managing quota\-setting processes.

* Expertise in Xactly Analytics configuration and reporting:
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Designing and configuring custom reports and dashboards.
+ Complex Report Building: Developing performance dashboards that aggregate sales data and compensation metrics.


**Knowledge Of The Following Technologies Is Considered An Asset**
* Microsoft SQL Server, Informatica, Xactly, Varicent
* Web technologies such as JavaScript, XML, CSS, and HTML
* BI Cognos reporting


 SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

title: Senior Analyst - Strategy Specialist
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an Analyst / Senior Analyst to join our Hyderabad office as part of the Strategy team. The Strategy team focuses on project acquisitions, PPA origination, market and corporate strategy, and capital raising. The team works closely across DESRI business units — including Finance, Development, EPC, Procurement, Legal, and FP\&A — to price risk and execute new opportunities that drive long\-term NAV growth. The candidate will be a part of an inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar, and storage projects within a dynamic environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Bid modeling and valuation for project acquisitions, PPA/ESA origination, repowers, and surplus BESS opportunities at any stage of the project life cycle.
* Assist in pricing and structuring bids targeting pre\-tax IRR and minimum NAV thresholds.
* Coordinate with EPC, Procurement, and Legal to validate assumptions and optimize site.
* Diligence support coordinating with DESRI Development \& EPC to evaluate project risk profiles.
* Conduct research on U.S. renewable markets covering financing markets, equipment pricing, competitor analysis, new markets, interconnection positions, and new technology
* synthesizing insights from public sources, utility proceedings, and internal databases.
* Contribute to battery strategy analysis, competitive intelligence, and management reporting on key market indicators.
* Prepare investor presentations, marketing materials, and support offtake diligence.


**Qualifications**
* Candidates holding MBA or relevant degree with 2–4 years of experience in investment banking, project finance, Strategy or consulting domain
* Strong financial modeling skills in Excel; ability to synthesize complex information into clear conclusions.
* Familiarity with renewable energy markets, PPA structures, and energy storage is preferred.
* Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and strong written and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams across teams in different time zones.
* Strong familiarity with usage of various AI models to optimize financial models, research and development and due diligence

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**

title: Educational Counsellor
description:
**Job Title: Educational Counsellor** 




**Experience: 3\-6 years** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




**Budget: 35\-45K \+ Incentives** 




  





**Job Brief** 




 We are looking for an
 **experienced Educational Counsellor** 
 to join our growing team.
 



 You will guide clients who want to move abroad for work, study, or other visa needs. You will understand their goals, explain the right visa options, and support them through the process.
 



**Training will be provided on visa processes for Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and Europe.** 




 This is a great role for someone who enjoys working with people, building trust, and helping clients achieve their overseas plans.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Speak with clients and understand their overseas plans.
* Explain visa options clearly and simply.
* Guide clients on the documents and steps needed.
* Handle client questions and follow up with them on time.
* Keep client records and case details up to date.
* Build strong and trusted client relationships.
* Follow up with leads and help convert them into clients.
* Stay updated on visa rules and process changes.
* Work with the team to give clients smooth and timely support.
* Complete assigned targets and support business growth.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience in
 **overseas immigration, visa consulting, or related sales** 
 is preferred.
* Good communication and client handling skills.
* Strong follow\-up and convincing skills.
* Good spoken and written English.
* Ability to understand client needs and explain options clearly.
* Positive attitude and a strong focus on results.
* Willingness to learn visa processes for new countries.
* Candidates with experience in Australia, New Zealand, UK, or Europe visa services will be an added advantage.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Get training on visa processes for
 **Australia, New Zealand, UK, and Europe** 
 .
* Work in a growing and people\-focused team.
* Build strong knowledge of global visa services.
* Get the chance to grow your career in the overseas immigration field.
* Work closely with clients and make a real difference in their overseas journey.
* Be part of a team that values learning, growth, and success.

You will be the liaison between Product and gTech services where needed, and will be responsible for ensuring that Product launches and customer\-facing migrations are seamlessly executed.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business\-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever\-changing global environment with fast\-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
   

  

 We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi\-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.

USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought\-after career option.

**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 11 AM to 8 PM

* Bachelor / Master degree in relation to Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or similar
* Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP GTS project implementation, and thus have significant knowledge of the SAP GTS Solution, in one of the following domains:
* Compliance Management
* Customs Management
* Trade Preference
* You have a good understanding of the supply chain management processes.
* Ability to travel up to 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Experience in other SAP modules than SAP GTS is an asset.
* Technical knowledge (e.g. ABAP, SAP PI…) is an asset
* You have good analytical and modeling skills.
* You are a team player with strong communication skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English

* Education with SAP focus (any of the following): S/4 or ECC Sales and Distribution, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Material Master, Transportation Management
* Software aptitude in PowerPoint, MS Project, Access, Excel, and/or Visio
* Experience presenting to clients or other decision makers
* Knowledge of export regulations including ITAR/EAR
* Demonstrated interest in international trade or international business
* Strong research, writing, verbal communication, and project management skills
* Ability to bring 'out of the box' solution design that is aligned to leading practices and differentiated business outcome
* Understanding of end\-to\-end processes and attention to detailed design.
* Strong team and organizational skills, ability to self\-manage time and tasks
* Ability to manage client and cross functional team expectations


 \#TAXGTS
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. * Deep understanding of CRM architecture, customization, configuration, and extension capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience in integrations, data migration, and enterprise solution design.
* Proven leadership in managing large, distributed teams and complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance technical delivery with business priorities and growth objectives.
* Experience in Agile/DevOps methodologies and modern delivery practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on quality, scalability, and performance.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
 The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
   

  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Total Experience: 12\+ years
* Relevant Experience: 12\+ years
* Proven track record of delivering Dynamics 365 CRM programs at scale.
* Strong exposure to client\-facing roles, including pre\-sales and business development.
* Experience working in global delivery models and cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications are preferred.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Forward deployed engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect \- Deccan AI
 



**About** 
 :
 



 Deccan AI is a venture\-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.
 



  





 Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission\-critical workflows. As we move from data and evals into full\-scale enterprise deployments, we're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect to sit at the center of that motion: embedded with customers, owning the technical relationship, and turning ambiguous problems into shipped, reliable AI systems.
 



  





 This is a customer\-facing, build\-heavy role. You will spend as much time in a client's codebase and infrastructure as you do in a whiteboard session with their VP of Engineering. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture and writing the code that proves it out.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Embed directly with enterprise customers to scope, design, and build production AI solutions on top of Deccan AI's Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical relationship for key accounts: requirements gathering, solution architecture, implementation, deployment, and post\-launch iteration.
* Translate ambiguous, often messy customer workflows into concrete technical designs data pipelines, agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and integration points with the customer's existing infra.
* Write production\-grade code alongside customer engineering teams; this is not a slideware role.
* Build reusable patterns, tooling, and accelerators from each engagement so the next deployment moves faster than the last.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer internally feeding field learnings back into product and platform roadmaps.
* Debug and resolve issues in live, high\-stakes deployments, often under time pressure and with imperfect information.
* Present architecture, tradeoffs, and rollout plans to both engineering counterparts and executive stakeholders.



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / professional\-services engineering role, ideally with exposure to AI, ML, or data\-intensive systems.
* Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or a modern backend language) you can prototype, productionize, and debug your own work, not just review someone else's.
* Experience designing and deploying systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including data pipelines and API\-level integrations.
* Working knowledge of LLM\-based systems: prompting, evaluation, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine\-tuning you don't need to have built a foundation model, but you need to have shipped something that uses one.
* Excellent communication skills you can move fluidly between a technical deep\-dive with engineers and a business conversation with a customer sponsor.
* A bias toward ownership: comfortable being the one person accountable for a customer's technical outcome, without a large team behind you at every step.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed and to work occasionally across customer time zones.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience in a forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role at an AI/ML or enterprise software company.
* Experience building or operating evaluation systems for AI agents or LLM applications.
* Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and production monitoring for AI systems.
* Startup experience, particularly in a 0\-to\-1 or early\-scale environment.



  





**Why Deccan AI** 



* Work at the point where AI research meets real enterprise deployment your work ships to production, not to a slide.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
* Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

* Provides technical leadership on specific integration activities that are part of an engagement

* Communicates across client community, and is viewed as adding value
* Contributes to knowledge tools and communities, and ensures project learning’s are documented and shared. Role models Focuses on single customer. Solves diverse and complex. May lead a project team

* Mastered at least one technical discipline with strong knowledge in at least three major technology areas
* Possesses advanced level of business, technical, or functional knowledge
* Ability to perform/drive resolution of problems on combinations and interactions of products
* Ability to apply technology and consulting to solve a client business problem
* Able to communicate and present complex issues with assurance and confidence
* Demonstrates the use of consulting skills including: questioning, listening, ideas development, permission and rapport, and influencing
* Ability to conduct/lead oral status/technical interchange meetings with clients on small to medium sized engagements
* Owns and produces customer documentation. Ability to translate technical details into concise and easy to understand written form. Ability to write relevant components of a proposal document (e.g. answer specific RFP questions). Ability to translate verbal requirements from face to face client meetings into requirements documents, statements of work, and proposals
* Able to discuss (within own area of expertise) requirements with a customer, and to challenge and clarify when appropriate. From the requirements, able to develop a high level design or plan, and then estimate the amount of effort required to deliver. Able to advise the engagement owner about the risks associated with this work package

Sika has subsidiaries in 101 countries around the world and manufactures in over 300 factories. Its 33,500 employees generated annual sales of CHF 10\.49 billion in 2022\.

title: Interior Design Consultant
description:
WE’RE HIRING Interior Design Consultant
 



 Studio Scintilla \| Powered by Craftsville
 



 📍 Gachibowli, Hyderabad \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 Design. Consult. Convert.
 



 Studio Scintilla is an end\-to\-end interior design and execution studio, established in 2016 and powered by Craftsville, our own in\-house modular factory.
 



 With 150\+ homes delivered, we create bespoke residential interiors from modular kitchens and wardrobes to complete home transformations backed by our in\-house 3D design and execution capabilities.
 



 We’re looking for an Interior Design Consultant who can bring together design understanding, client relationship skills, and a strong sales mindset.
 



  





 YOUR ROLE
 



 You’ll be the face of Studio Scintilla for prospective clients taking them from their first conversation to a signed project.
 



 You’ll understand their lifestyle and requirements, translate their ideas into a clear design direction, present concepts and materials, discuss budgets, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close.
 



  





 WHAT YOU’LL OWN
 



 Client Consultation
 



 • Manage clients from first inquiry through the sales process
 



 • Understand lifestyle, requirements, preferences, and budgets
 



 • Develop clear design briefs and manage client communication
 



 • Build trust and confidently guide clients through decisions
 



 Design \& Presentations
 



 • Create compelling mood boards and client presentations
 



 • Present portfolios, executed projects, concepts, and material options
 



 • Tailor presentations to make each client's vision feel personal and tangible
 



 Sales \& Commercial
 



 • Own the sales cycle — follow\-up → consultation → proposal → negotiation → closing
 



 • Prepare accurate quotations and budget proposals
 



 • Handle objections around budget, design, and timelines
 



 • Work towards individual and team sales targets
 



 Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with design, 3D, catalogue, execution, sales, and marketing teams
 



 • Ensure client requirements and quotations are realistic and deliverable
 



 • Bring client feedback and market insights back to the team
 



  





 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong understanding of interior design, styles, materials, and residential interiors
 



 • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
 



 • Experience creating mood boards, presentations, or proposals
 



 • Understanding of quotations, budgeting, and project scope
 



 • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and closing skills
 



 • Ability to qualify leads and manage follow\-ups/pipeline
 



 • Basic knowledge of Canva, PowerPoint, Keynote, or similar tools
 



 • Working knowledge of CRM or sales tracking tools
 



 • Understanding of the interior design/execution process
 



 • Comfortable with client meetings and site visits
 



 • Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and professional
 



  





 EXPERIENCE
 



 1–3 years of experience in:
 



 • Interior design sales / consulting
 



 • Real estate sales
 



 • Furniture / modular interiors
 



 • High\-ticket B2C sales
 



 A Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
 



 Prior experience in interior design, modular furniture, or real estate is strongly preferred.
 



 Candidates from strong sales backgrounds with a genuine understanding of interiors are also encouraged to apply.
 



  





 WHY STUDIO SCINTILLA?
 



 150\+ homes delivered.
 



 In\-house 3D design.
 



 In\-house execution.
 



 Powered by Craftsville.
 



 Join a team where you’ll have real ownership, real client interaction, and a direct impact on revenue and the client experience without the outsourcing gaps between design and execution.
 



  





 READY TO JOIN US?
 


* 📩 To apply: Send your portfolio/resume to team@scintillainterio.in or DM us directly.

 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Industry Consultant for Insurance, you will guide insurance organizations through modernization journeys by aligning business strategy with digital capabilities. This role involves leveraging industry acumen to drive business outcomes, with a focus on improving customer engagement and implementing data\-driven risk assessment models.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

 Master's Degree

* Automation Implementation: Exposure to driving automation in insurance organizations, including process automation and workflow optimization.
* Business Strategy Development: Exposure to developing business strategies that align with digital capabilities and industry trends, with a focus on improving customer engagement and driving business outcomes.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Data Analysis Skills: Exposure to data analysis and modeling techniques to implement data\-driven risk assessment models.
* Process Automation: Knowledge of process automation and workflow optimization in insurance organizations.
* Digital Technologies: Understanding of digital technologies and their application in the insurance industry.

title: Supplier Enablement Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 The R2P Supplier Enablement Sr Analyst role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end supplier enablement and digital transaction adoption across the enterprise within the Requisition\-to\-Pay (R2P) Operations \& Support organization. This role owns supplier onboarding, SAP Ariba Network enablement, enterprise licensing adoption, transaction readiness, and supplier success outcomes, ensuring suppliers can transact digitally through approved platforms in a timely, compliant, and sustainable manner. The role acts as both a project lead and trusted advisor to suppliers and internal stakeholders, leveraging techno\-functional expertise to accelerate adoption, resolve complex challenges, and maximize business value realization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Supplier Onboarding \& Transaction Enablement
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end supplier onboarding and enablement activities, including registration, account strategy assessment, supplier segmentation, Enterprise Account enablement, catalog readiness, transaction configuration, and compliance validation to support digital commerce objectives. (Executes)
* Drive SAP Ariba Network enablement and enterprise licensing adoption, educating suppliers on platform capabilities, account structures, subscription options, transaction requirements, and best practices to maximize platform utilization and business value. (Executes)
* Manage supplier enablement engagements as structured projects with defined timelines, deliverables, success criteria, stakeholder communication plans, and adoption milestones. (Owns)
* Perform techno\-functional assessments of supplier capabilities and transaction readiness, identifying integration, configuration, process, and operational gaps that may impact electronic transaction adoption. (Executes)
* Partner with suppliers, SAP Ariba support teams, integration teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve onboarding, connectivity, invoicing, catalog, purchase order, and transaction processing challenges. (Executes)
* Ensure supplier enablement activities adhere to enterprise compliance, risk management, master data governance, security, and system control requirements, escalating exceptions and risks as necessary. (Owns)


 Supplier Support \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Act as the primary point of accountability for supplier enablement success, monitoring supplier progress from onboarding through steady\-state adoption and transaction compliance. (Owns)
* Establish and track supplier adoption metrics including transaction volume, invoice compliance, electronic invoicing utilization, catalog adoption, PO automation rates, and overall network engagement. (Executes)
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, transaction failures, process inefficiencies, and supplier experience challenges, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. (Owns)
* Engage directly with supplier leadership and operational teams to drive issue resolution, adoption acceleration, and long\-term supplier success. (Executes)
* Manage escalations involving complex business, operational, integration, configuration, or system\-related issues, coordinating resolution across SAP Ariba, Procurement, Finance, IT, and Governance teams. (Leads)
* Provide consultation and guidance on SAP Ariba functionality, transaction troubleshooting, best practices, and process optimization opportunities. (Consulted)


 Documentation, Adoption \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Maintain supplier\-facing documentation, training materials, enablement playbooks, process guides, and knowledge repositories to support scalable global enablement efforts. (Owns)
* Analyze supplier enablement performance, transaction adoption trends, operational metrics, and recurring issues to identify root causes and drive sustainable improvements. (Executes)
* Create adoption dashboards, supplier success scorecards, project status reporting, and executive\-level insights to support governance and decision\-making. (Executes)
* Recommend process enhancements, automation opportunities, and platform optimization initiatives to improve supplier experience, operational efficiency, and compliance outcomes. (Consulted / Leads)
* Support enterprise supplier migration initiatives, digital transformation programs, and SAP Ariba capability expansion projects, ensuring successful supplier adoption and change management. (Executes)


 Collaboration \& Governance Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Finance, IT, Master Data, Risk, Compliance, SAP Ariba, and Governance teams to develop and execute supplier enablement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives. (Consulted / Executes)
* Influence supplier and stakeholder decision\-making through data\-driven recommendations, adoption insights, and subject matter expertise in supplier enablement and SAP Ariba processes. (Executes)
* Participate in governance forums, operational reviews, supplier performance discussions, and transformation initiatives to ensure alignment with business priorities and digital procurement goals. (Consulted)
* Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for supplier enablement strategy, enterprise licensing adoption, supplier experience, and SAP Ariba operational excellence initiatives. (Owns)


**Qualifications**
* 9\-11 years of experience in supplier enablement or procurement operations, with exposure to downstream AP operations within a shared services or global delivery environment
* Hands\-on experience supporting supplier onboarding or transaction enablement in SAP environments
* Experience working in a global or multi\-regional operating model

**Job Description**
 Lead Consultant \- Oracle Cloud Planning (EPM)
   

  

**About Argano**
 Argano is the world’s largest global digital consultancy, exclusively connecting design and delivery for the transformation of high\-performance business operations, extending our clients’ commercial agility, profitability, customer experience, and growth. Our strategic consulting, bolstered by proprietary IP, provides a comprehensive view of business operations, pinpointing areas of strength and unveiling opportunities for improvement. Argano is at the intersection of operations and technology for digital transformation.
   

  

**Lead Consultant \- Oracle Cloud Planning (EPM)**
**Job Summary**
 A Lead Consultant at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for managing mid to large\-size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. They are indirect mentors to other areas and grades. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively. Lead consultants work with security, data management, and crisis management and should demonstrate exceptional knowledge of technology to deliver quality work that will drive customer satisfaction, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work well within a team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead mid to large\-size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.
* Develop and implement long\-term client strategies.
* Successfully lead implementations by gathering system and business requirements, designing, and building Planning Cloud solutions, including writing calculation scripts and building applications from end to end.
* Lead other technical team members in the delivery of EPM/BI solutions while providing leading practice business process solutions to customers
* Act as both a functional and technical expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and technology requirements. Conduct thorough assessments to identify areas where technology can drive improvements and efficiencies.
* Provide expert advice on technology solutions and tools that can enhance the client's operations. Help clients make informed decisions about adopting and implementing new technologies.
* Collaborate with third\-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
* Offer ongoing technical support to address any issues or concerns that arise after implementation.
* Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.


**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree, or PhD.


**Experience**
* Experience Leading 5\-6 different, full\-lifecycle Oracle Planning Cloud implementations
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required
* Experience leading functional and technical design sessions and implementing Oracle Planning Cloud solutions
* Experience implementing Oracle Planning Cloud Modules such as Workforce, CapEx, Projects, PCM, or Strategic Modeling
* Experience leading a team of consultants and properly managing deliverables
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills required
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Data Management and loading data and metadata a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.
* Previous experience working in IT companies.
* In\-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems..


**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**
* Oracle Enterprise Performance Management Cloud Service Implementation Specialist – preferred
* Oracle Hyperion Planning 11 Certified Implementation Specialist – preferred
* Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service 2021 Certified Implementation Specialist – preferred


**Skill Requirements**
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Complex Project Management: Senior Consultants are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
* Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
* Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.
* Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid\-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
* Strategic Vision: Senior Consultants should contribute to the firm's strategic vision and decision\-making.
* Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

**About Kinaxis**
 Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai, India
   

  

**About The Team**
 As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
   

  

****What you will do****

* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs

* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.


****What we are looking for****
* Candidates with results\-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6\+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast\-paced project environment and co\-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage


 \#Senior
   

  

**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**

description:

 Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) platform and related platform components, ensuring they effectively meet evolving business needs, perform optimally, and are regularly improved to support strategic objectives and innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Act as the central point of contact for all SAP BDC functionality, ensuring continuous alignment with business strategies and process requirements.

* Partner with other IT teams working on BDC components like Datasphere or SAC to translate requirements into SAP BDC configurations
* Identify and implement SAP Data Products, Insight apps or enhancements to improve user experience and increase productivity, ensuring the BDC platform supports emerging business needs.
* Define and oversee platform solution architecture standards and development guidelines and perform implementation reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation in close alignment with enterprise archtecture standards
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless business solution implementations and integrations with other platforms (e.g., Databricks), ensuring that SAP BDC acts as the central hub for reporting \& analytics on SAP data.
* Analyze technical as well as data requirements and translate them into functional specifications for implementation of custom data products
* Manage relationships with SAP and third\-party service providers, ensuring that SAP BDC service levels and support or customizations meet technical, business and compliance requirements
* Coordinate with SAP for procurement decisions related to credit consumption, additional licenses, modules, or software that enhance the capabilities of the existing SAP BDC landscape
* Ensure proper change \& release management processes on the platform to control deployments Effective user training is in place to provide on\-demand learning and support.
* Engage and manage stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Ensure SAP BDC meets the organization’s security requirements, including securing user roles and access control using SAP Identity Management (IdM) or SAP GRC.
* Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support compliance audits, leveraging SAP's audit logging capabilities and tracking of system changes to ensure data integrity


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Strong understanding of SAP related data management and governance principles
* Extensive knowledge of SAP technologies (BDC, SAC, BTP, BW) with a proven track record of successful implementation and integration in the data analytics area
* Understanding of main Technology feature supporting data management and analytic
* Technical leadership role model for delivering of POVs/POCs and to oversee the development of data platform features
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex data challenges.

**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)


**Languages**
 English

title: BC Sector-Life Sciences-ED
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The GDS Forecasting COE Leader is a senior leadership role accountable for building, scaling, and running a Center of Excellence dedicated to commercial forecasting services for Life Sciences clients. The role sits at the intersection of consulting go\-to\-market growth, delivery, analytics capability\-building, and commercial performance. It owns the COE talent and methodology backbone and positions forecasting as a differentiated offering within the broader Life Sciences practice. Reporting to the Life Sciences GDS Leader, the role is the primary escalation point for client delivery quality and internal capability development.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**Go\-to\-Market**
* Partner with solution, account, and sector leaders to identify, shape, and pursue forecasting\-led opportunities across existing and prospective client accounts.
* Lead or co\-lead proposal development, including solution design, pricing strategy, and staffing plans for forecasting engagements and RFPs.
* Build reusable forecasting assets including accelerators, frameworks, demo models, and points of view to reduce proposal cycle time and improve win rates.
* Represent the COE in client pitches, oral presentations, and executive discussions.
* Track and report the COE sales pipeline, win/loss trends, revenue contribution, and forecast to Life Sciences leadership.
* Develop and publish thought leadership, benchmarking studies, and conference content to establish market credibility.
* Identify and evaluate strategic alliances with forecasting technology and data partners to strengthen the solution stack.


**Delivery**
* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of forecasting deliverables across COE\-supported engagements.
* Lead engagements spanning customized platform or solution development and forecasting managed services.
* Establish and enforce model validation, assumption documentation, MAPE/accuracy tracking, peer review, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Define and continuously refine forecasting methodologies, matching the approach to the business question and available data.
* Provide technical oversight over gross\-to\-net modeling, loss\-ofexclusivity impact, TRx/NBRx trends, market sizing, competitive dynamics, and related parameters.
* Manage engagement economics, including utilization, effort estimates, and margin performance.
* Build and mentor a multi\-tiered team from analysts through senior managers, balancing pharmaceutical commercial expertise and analytics capability.
* Institutionalize lessons learned, client feedback, and forecast\-accuracy post\-mortems into refreshed playbooks and training.
* Guide adoption of forecasting platforms and tools, including AI\-first and agentic forecasting architectures where relevant.
* Act as the escalation point for at\-risk engagements and resolve delivery, staffing, or client relationship issues.


**Analytical/Decision Making** 
**Responsibilities**
* Determine the appropriate forecasting methodology, model architecture, data sources, validation approach, and governance level for complex client needs.
* Prioritize investments across talent, assets, platforms, alliances, and adjacent capabilities based on pipeline, scalability, and expected value.
* Balance growth, quality, utilization, margin, and talent sustainability across the COE portfolio.
* Make senior interventions on at\-risk engagements and decide when models, assumptions, staffing, or delivery plans require correction.
* Translate quantitative model outputs and uncertainty into clear commercial decisions and executive narratives.


**Education \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Statistics, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field from a reputed institution; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.
* 14\+ years of overall experience, including at least 8\-10 years in pharmaceutical or Life Sciences commercial forecasting.
* Experience in a top\-tier consulting firm, pharmaceutical commercial analytics function, or specialized forecasting firm is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a COE, practice area, or specialized delivery team, including P\&L or revenue accountability.
* Proven client\-facing delivery leadership across complex, multi\-market forecasting engagements.
* Experience managing large, distributed teams across onshore\-offshore delivery models.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Deep expertise in pharmaceutical commercial forecasting, including MAPE, gross\-to\-net, loss of exclusivity, TRx/NBRx, market share dynamics, and epidemiology\- and analogue\-based methods.
* Strong familiarity with pharmaceutical data platforms and datasets, including IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health, claims, and EHR data.
* Proficiency in Excel modeling, R, Python, and forecasting\-specific platforms; familiarity with AI/ML forecasting and agentic AI applications is highly desirable.
* Strong business development capability across proposal writing, client pitching, pricing, and senior relationship management.
* Proven people leadership across team building, performance management, mentoring, and capability development.
* Executive presence and the ability to translate complex quantitative outputs into clear business narratives.
* Understanding of the broader Life Sciences commercial ecosystem, including market access, patient engagement, and competitive intelligence.
* Strong governance and risk orientation, with attention to model accuracy, documentation rigor, and audit readiness.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Essential
